Мне дорога моя девушка и работа важна, поэтому ради этой игры пришлось пожертвовать сном и начать спать по 4 часа в среднем.

По геймплею - то ли баротравма, то ли проект зомбоид в космосе с генами Hardspace:Shipbreaker.

Я абсолютно понимаю негативные комментарии об игре из-за которых сомневался в покупке.
Да, она несколько багованная (хотя критических я не встречал, разве что однажды случайно умер и обнаружил, что автосохранение не работало последние 3 часа)
Да, я даже не зная ничего об игре до выхода "в релиз" вижу, что авторы задумывали раз в 10 больше контента, но споткнулись об амбиции. Ну моды прикрутили и то хорошо, фанаты допилят.
Да, оптимизация местами хромает (справедливости ради играю и на калькуляторе на работе нередко и на домашнем компе, оптимизация тут не зависит от железа, длительнейшие сохранения, фризы и падения ФПС вы испытаете в любом случае)
Да, ИИ тупейший. Показательный пример: боты на станции заметили пожар и побежали его тушить. Снаружи. Даже те, у кого были скафандры - шлемы не надели. Налутал я с них знатно. Захватил пирата с баунти за голову, запер в комнате с запасом еды и воды - он всё пытался выйти наружу воспользоваться кофейным автоматом, делая по тысяче просчётов маршрута в секунду, и из-за этого у меня ФПС падал до 1-10 кадров в секунду. И подобное происходит регулярно.
Да менеджмент инвентаря обычно ад из матрёшки. 
Да, редактор персонажа странный. Предполагается, что твой персонаж будет либо рандомным, но, потенциально, сильнее. Либо такой какой ты сам соберёшь. Но через пару созданий персонажа ты понимаешь как абузить систему и сесть на два стула.
Ну и да, порог вхождения немаленький. Даже несмотря на обучение и гайды (в том числе внутриигровые)


Но господи, как же я кайфанул несмотря на это. Пилишь себе кораблики в космосе. Или восстанавливаешь. Обустраиваешь своё корыто или копишь на новое. Обычный такой космический работяга. Где-то там вокруг крутится огромный мир, который только предстоит исследовать. Накопить денег, стать дальнобоем и купить там квартиру после первого рейса? А может стать шахтёром на астероидах, говорят такая возможность тоже где-то есть? А может стать баунти-хантером? Курьером? Или спиться водкой ночуя в спальном мешке в куче окурков на флотилии? И даже для этого тебе придётся реально включить голову чтобы понять, как это всё работает! Чувствуется какой-то интерес. Жизнь, движуха.

我的女朋友对我很重要，工作也很重要，所以为了这款游戏，我不得不牺牲睡眠，开始平均每天只睡4个小时。

就玩法而言——这要么是气压创伤，要么是太空中的僵尸项目，带着《Hardspace:Shipbreaker》的基因。

我完全理解那些关于这款游戏的负面评论，正因为它们我才对购买犹豫不决。
是的，它有些bug（虽然我没遇到过什么严重的，除非有一次我意外死了，然后发现自动存档在过去3个小时里根本没工作）
是的，即使我在“正式发布”之前对这款游戏一无所知，我也能看出作者原本设想的內容要多出10倍，但被野心绊倒了。不过好歹把mod接上了，这也不错，粉丝们会把它补完的。
是的，优化在某些地方很糟糕（公平地说，我经常在工作的计算器上玩，也在家里的电脑上玩，这里的优化不取决于硬件，超长的保存时间、卡顿和帧数下降你无论如何都会遇到）
是的，AI蠢到极点。一个典型的例子：空间站上的机器人发现了火灾，然后跑去灭火。从外面。即使是那些有宇航服的——也没戴上头盔。我从它们身上搜刮了不少好东西。我抓了一个有悬赏的赏金海盗，把他锁在一个有食物和水的房间里——他一直试图出去用咖啡机，每秒进行上千次路径计算，因此我的帧数掉到了每秒1-10帧。类似的事情经常发生。
是的，物品栏管理通常是套娃式的地狱。
是的，角色编辑器很奇怪。按理说你的角色要么是随机的，但可能更强。要么就是你自己捏出来的那个。但创建过几个角色之后，你就明白怎么滥用这个系统，然后两头占便宜了。
嗯，是的，入门门槛不低。即使有教程和攻略（包括游戏内的）也一样


但是天哪，尽管如此我还是玩得太爽了。在太空里给自己造小船。或者修复。布置自己的破船，或者攒钱买新的。就是个普通的太空打工人。周围某个地方转动着一个巨大的世界，等着你去探索。攒钱，成为长途货运司机，然后跑完第一趟就在那儿买套公寓？或者成为小行星矿工，据说这种机会也在某个地方存在？或者成为赏金猎人？快递员？还是在舰队里睡在睡袋里、躺在一堆烟头中喝伏特加喝到烂醉？甚至为了做到这些，你都得真正动脑子去搞明白这一切是怎么运作的！能感觉到某种趣味。生活，活力。

6/10
 -- [!! F U N !!   BUT   D I S A P O I N T I N G] --

My hour count is a result of a lack of games to play, nevertheless,  this game has been fun but at every moment past the 15hr mark I've thought to myself "where's the content?"

Essentially if you're the type that enjoys grindy and overly complicated complete freedom sandbox games (kenshi, rimworld, etc), then you'll enjoy it, but likely come to the same opinion as me.

------------------------------------------
SHIP BUILDING AND DESIGN LACKS SERIOUS DEPTH
      Half the game is grinding away at building your space ship, yet there is so little to build decoration and functionality wise. You have two types of chairs, three types of tables, and no real interior decoration other than painfully matching correct floor variants you rarely find (like 5 decor items I can think of that aren't those).
     For functional parts, you just need a ship battery, thruster, pilot seat, and two air pumps (one for O2 and N2). Then you have your fully functional space ship with it's core systems and sadly, it doesn't get much more in depth than that beyond building your first ship's fusion reactor. Like theres no need to build a dedicated life support room on your ship, managing lifesupport systems is as simple as placing an air pump inside a room. It doesn't even matter where you place your thrusters, sensors, or anything. As long as if it's on the ship it flies. It just really feels lackluster, like there's no solar panels, no ship shield room to set-up, no crafting room, etc. The variety for what is there is also very limited. You'd expect water to be an important resource in space, but it's not here. You'll just be storing gallons in your fridge.
-------------------------------------------
LACKING LOOT VARIETY
You'll always be finding the same exact stuff in chests and crates aboard every single ship. Its not exciting.
------------------------------------------
WORTHLESS TRAITS
Theres a wide plethora of traits in character creation, half of which no one has any clue as to what they do. Is cooking a hobby? Well thats never coming up again, and your not going to be cooking anything because its not a feature. Theres just so much that does truely nothing
------------------------------------------
LACKING QOL
There's just so so so much QOL that is lacking, especially when it comes to ship design. Character pathfinding is awful and dumb. Theres a ship building mode in the game, but you cannot import your designs or ANYTHING made in that mode to the real game. There is no planning mode. Darkness always makes building difficult, you can never get a full view of your ship you are working on. To remedy this you can use a 'visor' such as a 'price visor' which removes the darkness and color codes items by their relative value. But in that mode you cannot see any orders you have issued, any walls you set to be constructed, flooring you just ordered your character to put down, etc.
------------------------------------------
VERY ANNOYING CHARACTER NEED BAR MANAGEMENT
Your character has mental needs, such as socialization, talking to family, etc. To solve these it is a tedious task of right clicking your character, and pressing the correct hotkey that lowers the need bar over 20 times or be penalized stat wise. Im not joking, it's incredibly stupid. You will literally spend 3 minutes IRL spam clicking "browse social media, long for a better love life, remember family, etc" to make your need bars go down to keep your character happy. These systems ARE NOT ENGAGING IN ANY WAY and are my biggest gripe with the game.
------------------------------------------
!! BUGGY & UNOPTIMIZED!!
Admittedly, I haven't experience a save breaking bug a save and reload can't fix, but it's annoying coming across bugs that require you to reload the game in order to continue playing. Also, runs a bit hot for what it is and saving and loading takes ages.
------------------------------------------

-- THE REASON THIS IS A POSITIVE REVIEW STILL --
At the end of it all, I still enjoy this game but am disappointed constantly. What is keeping me playing is the exploration and that sense of progression. There really is a ton to explore, space is huge in this game. But the progression is what is really keeping me coming back, you start with rags and work your way to riches and that is just incredibly fun and well done in this game.

6/10
 -- [!! 有 趣 !!   但   令 人 失 望] --

我的游戏时长是因为没什么别的游戏可玩，尽管如此，这游戏一直挺有趣，但过了15小时之后，我每时每刻都在想“内容在哪？”

基本上，如果你是那种喜欢肝、过于复杂、完全自由的沙盒游戏（kenshi、rimworld等）的人，那你会喜欢它，但很可能最终得出和我一样的看法。

------------------------------------------
飞船建造和设计严重缺乏深度
      游戏的一半时间都花在建造你的太空飞船上，但在装饰和功能方面可建造的东西却少得可怜。你只有两种椅子、三种桌子，除了那些你很少能找到的、需要痛苦地匹配正确的地板变体之外，没有任何真正的室内装饰（我能想到的除了那些之外大概只有5种装饰物品）。
     至于功能部件，你只需要一个飞船电池、推进器、驾驶座和两个气泵（一个用于O2，一个用于N2）。然后你就有了拥有核心系统的完全可用的太空飞船，可悲的是，除了建造你第一艘飞船的聚变反应堆之外，它并不会变得更有深度。就像你不需要在飞船上建造专门的生命维持室，管理生命维持系统就像在房间里放一个气泵一样简单。你把推进器、传感器或其他任何东西放在哪里都无所谓。只要它在飞船上，它就能飞。这真的让人感觉很乏味，就像没有太阳能板、没有需要设置的飞船护盾室、没有制作室等等。现有的东西种类也非常有限。你会以为水在太空中是一种重要资源，但这里不是。你只会把几加仑水储存在冰箱里。
-------------------------------------------
战利品缺乏多样性
你在每一艘飞船上的箱子和板条箱里总是会找到完全相同的东西。这并不令人兴奋。
------------------------------------------
毫无价值的特质
角色创建中有大量特质，其中一半没人知道它们到底有什么用。烹饪是一种爱好吗？嗯，这再也不会出现了，而且你也不会烹饪任何东西，因为它不是一个功能。有太多东西真的什么都不做
------------------------------------------
缺乏生活质量改进
缺乏的生活质量改进实在是太多太多了，尤其是在飞船设计方面。角色寻路糟糕又愚蠢。游戏里有一个飞船建造模式，但你不能把你的设计或在该模式中制作的任何东西导入到真正的游戏中。没有规划模式。黑暗总是让建造变得困难，你永远无法完整地看到你正在建造的飞船。为了解决这个问题，你可以使用一个“面罩”，比如“价格面罩”，它会消除黑暗并根据物品的相对价值给它们上色。但在那个模式下，你看不到你发出的任何命令、你设置为要建造的任何墙壁、你刚刚命令角色铺设的地板等等。
------------------------------------------
非常烦人的角色需求条管理
你的角色有心理需求，比如社交、与家人交谈等等。要解决这些需求，就得繁琐地右键点击你的角色，然后按正确的热键超过20次来降低需求条，否则就会受到属性惩罚。我不是开玩笑，这蠢得难以置信。你真的会花3分钟在现实中狂点“浏览社交媒体、渴望更好的爱情生活、想念家人等等”，让你的需求条降下来，以保持你的角色开心。这些系统在任何方面都毫无吸引力，是我对这游戏最大的不满。
------------------------------------------
!! 有BUG且未优化!!
诚然，我还没有遇到过保存并重新加载无法修复的坏档BUG，但遇到需要你重新加载游戏才能继续玩的BUG还是很烦人。而且，就它这个体量来说，运行起来有点烫，保存和加载也要花很长时间。
------------------------------------------

-- 这仍然是一条好评的原因 --
归根结底，我仍然喜欢这个游戏，但也不断感到失望。让我继续玩下去的是探索和那种进步感。确实有大量东西可以探索，这个游戏里的太空非常巨大。但真正让我不断回来的是进度推进，你从衣衫褴褛开始，一路努力走向富有，这在这游戏里真的非常有趣，而且做得很好。
让你的角色保持开心。这些系统在任何方面都毫无吸引力，是我对这款游戏最大的不满。
------------------------------------------
！！有漏洞且未优化！！
诚然，我还没遇到过保存并重新加载无法修复的坏档漏洞，但遇到需要重新加载游戏才能继续游玩的漏洞还是很烦人。另外，就它这个体量而言，运行起来有点烫，而且保存和加载要花很长时间。
------------------------------------------

—— 这仍然是一条好评的原因 ——
归根结底，我仍然喜欢这款游戏，但也不断感到失望。让我继续玩下去的是探索和那种成长感。这款游戏里真的有太多东西可以探索，太空非常浩瀚。但真正让我不断回来的还是成长进程，你从衣衫褴褛起步，一路打拼到腰缠万贯，而这在这款游戏里就是极其有趣，而且做得非常好。

Fun for a bit but the more you play the more it's clear this isn't close to finished. this was quite clearly kicked out of early access by factors external to game development.  aka the publisher, financial reasons or the dev maybe being sick of it??

i'd call it maybe 50% done.

i spent far too much time at the starting station and now that i've gone out and explored the system it's like an empty mall

there's basically 3 functional locations and a dozen more that are empty apart from a few basic NPC's and standard services. 
CQB combat and social gameplay are virtually identical and feel completely unimplemented. they're basically press button to be friendly / not so friendly. for example flirting consists of making a single weird facial expression over and over and over and over again. and you experience that in a scrolling text field.

Crew management is like the sims with terrible AI. it's just obnoxious. when i restarted a fresh save i just didn't bother getting any more crew than the player character.

What is fun and implemented well:

- Ship navigation (RCS or torch drive) it really feels like you're steering a brick through space or a brick tied to a nuclear reactor that's throwing fusion exhaust out of the bottom.
- Ship to ship combat.  caveat: it's basically isolated to 1 location unless you go full murderhobo

What's okay

- Constructing your ship.  it works but oh dear lord is it tedious to design and modify your brick
- Mining.   it's functional and somewhat tied in with ship combat (it's a contested zone).  but not particularly amazing. it's fine.

what's bad:

- Crew control.  Half the time the autotask stops working for some inexplicable reason and you have to take care of every persons needs the sims style.  literally half of the needs are convoluted and annoying to deal with (the social needs) where 1 is almost impossible to satisfy (altruism) 
- 80% of the solarsystem is bland empty stations with nothing special to do.
- Social / CBQ combat.  it's spamming the same things over and over to achieve the desired result with little in the way of useful feedback.
- The performance is atrocious.  loading takes ages, saving takes ages, the autotask function stutters the game constantly if you make your character build something as simple as a 10x10 floor
- There's 0 quality of life.    that 10x10 floor?   you'd better have manually filled some backpacks with flooring cause otherwise your character will grab them 1 by 1 by 1.  i'm just glad there's a mod that helps with picking up 100 pieces of floor first. cause the alternative is that you basically do that manually!

玩一会儿挺有趣，但你玩得越多就越清楚这离完成还差得远。这很明显是被游戏开发之外的因素踢出了抢先体验。也就是发行商、财务原因，或者开发者可能自己都玩腻了？？

我会说它大概完成了50%。

我在起始空间站花了太多时间，而现在我出去探索了这个星系，它就像一座空荡荡的商场

基本上只有3个有功能的地点，还有十几个除了几个基础NPC和标准服务之外空空如也的地方。
室内近战和社交玩法几乎一模一样，感觉完全没有实装。它们基本上就是按按钮来表示友好/不那么友好。比如调情就是一遍又一遍又一遍又一遍地做一个奇怪的面部表情。而你是在一个滚动文本框里体验这些的。

船员管理就像AI糟糕透顶的《模拟人生》。就是很烦人。当我重开一个新存档时，我干脆懒得招募任何超出玩家角色之外的船员。

好玩且实现得不错的部分：

- 飞船导航（RCS或火炬驱动）真的感觉像是在太空中驾驶一块砖头，或者一块绑在核反应堆上、从底部喷出聚变尾焰的砖头。
- 舰对舰战斗。但有个前提：除非你彻底化身杀人狂，否则它基本上只局限于1个地点

还行的部分

- 建造你的飞船。它能用，但天哪，设计和修改你这块砖头真是太繁琐了
- 采矿。它能用，而且某种程度上和舰船战斗挂钩（那是个争夺区）。但并不是特别惊艳。还行吧。

糟糕的部分：

- 船员控制。有一半时间自动任务会因为某些莫名其妙的原因停止工作，你就得像《模拟人生》那样照顾每个人的需求。字面上一半的需求都复杂又烦人（社交需求），其中1个几乎不可能满足（利他主义）
- 太阳系的80%都是平淡空洞的空间站，没什么特别可做的。
- 社交/室内近战。就是一遍又一遍地重复同样的事情来达到想要的结果，几乎没有什么有用的反馈。
- 性能糟糕透顶。加载要花很久，保存要花很久，如果你让你的角色建造一个简单到只有10x10的地板，自动任务功能就会让游戏不断卡顿
- 生活质量改进为0。那个10x10的地板？你最好已经手动往几个背包里装好了地板材料，否则你的角色会一块一块一块地拿。我真庆幸有个mod能帮忙先捡起100块地板。因为替代方案基本上就是你得手动去做！

items.text:
[h1]Ostranauts - świetny szkielet, który wciąż czeka na właściwą grę[/h1]

Gra kusi obietnicami wysokiego poziomu symulacji i ciekawymi metodami budowania statków kosmicznych. Ale czy tych obietnic dotrzymuje?

[b]Poniekąd tak.[/b]

Można spędzić wiele godzin na szukaniu wartych splądrowania wraków, sprzedawaniu komponentów, byle tylko starczyło na hipotekę, a kiedy ma się już trochę pieniędzy - na ulepszaniu swojego okrętu. Tworzymy wtedy jakiś nieboży amalgamat posklejany z dziesiątek innych statków.

Po drodze robimy małe śledztwa detektywistyczne, aż w końcu dochodzimy do momentu, w którym możemy flipować gruzy z dużym zyskiem. A jeśli dobrze się postaramy, znajdzie się nawet miejsce na własny reaktor fuzyjny.

I trzeba przyznać - [b]samo robienie tego jest całkiem ciekawe.[/b]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Problem zaczyna się wtedy, kiedy już zrobimy to, co mieliśmy zrobić[/h2]

[b]Po co?[/b]

I to jest największa bolączka, jaką mam z tą grą. [i]Ostranauts[/i] to po prostu bardzo dobry szkielet symulacji kosmicznej, ale mam wrażenie, że na tym szkielecie wciąż brakuje właściwej gry.

Postawiłeś reaktor i odblokowałeś podróż międzyplanetarną? Spoko. Tylko po co właściwie wybierać się na inne planety? Podróż trwa kupę czasu, nie wiesz, co tam zastaniesz, musisz wcześniej przygotować odpowiednie kwatery i zapasy, a ostatecznie raczej nie czeka tam na ciebie nic przełomowego.

Interakcje społeczne są dość kiepskie. Jeśli chcesz, żeby ktoś został twoim przyjacielem, to w zasadzie wystarczy wystarczająco długo z nim gadać. A kiedy już jesteście przyjaciółmi - co dalej? Nic specjalnego. Może trochę łatwiej da się go zwerbować czy coś, ale o załodze jeszcze za chwilę.

Ulepszyłeś statek, masz fajne silniki i sporo paliwa, więc możesz podróżować dalej. Tylko co z tego? Nie spotykasz lepszych wraków ani szczególnie ciekawych przeszkód.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Piraci i konsekwencje (a raczej ich brak)[/h2]

Czasami na wraku można spotkać pirata. Swoją drogą, pirat siedzący zupełnie sam na wraku, bez zadokowanego własnego statku, rodzi pytanie:

[b]Co on tam w ogóle robi?[/b]

Takiego pirata można bez większych problemów rozwalić. Ale załóżmy, że nasza postać nie jest maszyną do zabijania i chcemy go oszczędzić. Nokautujesz go i zabierasz na swój statek. Po chwili delikwent wstaje i mimo że jest bezbronny, rzuca się na ciebie i każe oddawać fanty.

Więc jaka jest opcja na rozprawienie się z piratami?

[b]Wystrzelenie ich w otchłań kosmosu.[/b]

Nasza postać oczywiście w żaden sposób nie przeżywa traumy związanej z odebraniem komuś życia.

Można również werbować załogę, ale wydawanie rozkazów jednej postaci było już wystarczająco toporne, a większa załoga jest bardzo kosztowna - zarówno jeśli chodzi o pieniądze w grze, jak i o twój komputer.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Performance[/h2]

[b]Jasny gwint.[/b]

Czy ta gra działa na jednym wątku, czy o co tutaj chodzi?

Załóżmy, że dokujesz do średniej wielkości wraku. Najpierw wydajesz rozkaz, żeby twój ludzik zdemontował 20 ścian i podłóg. Odpalasz prędkość x16. Czasem chrupnie, ale jakoś to idzie.

Potem wydajesz rozkaz, żeby utworzyć nowe pomieszczenie na swoim statku. Rozkładasz siatkę podłogi i dookoła stawiasz ściany.

[b]I jest koniec.[/b]

Nie wiem, czy logika dostarczania przedmiotów sprawdza każdą kratkę twojego statku i wraku, ale ściny są momentami nierealne. Jeśli chcesz postawić 20 podłóg, wygląda to tak, jakby wszystkie kratki były sprawdzane 20 razy, a kiedy gra już wszystko przemieli, nagle jest OK.

A mówimy tutaj o pomieszczeniu 4×5. Co się stanie, jeśli ktoś będzie chciał zbudować pomieszczenie 20×10?

Do tego dochodzą długie loadingi i głupie AI. Potrzebujesz pięciu takich samych przedmiotów? Zamiast podnieść cały stack pięciu, postać woli zrobić pięć osobnych wycieczek.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Świat[/h2]

Niestety świat jest również bardzo pusty i sprawia wrażenie makiety.

Na stacji kosmicznej zawsze jesteś jedynym zadokowanym statkiem. Nigdy nie zobaczysz NPC-a, który przyleci, zadokuje albo odleci. Jeśli podlecisz do wraku, do którego NPC już zadokował, to ten NPC faktycznie tam będzie - ale nic nie robi.

Możesz więc po prostu ograbić wrak, a on nawet nie zwróci na ciebie uwagi.

Jeszcze lepiej jest, kiedy przylecisz do miejscówki piratów i wymontujesz istotny dla tamtejszego reaktora komponent. Nikt nie zareaguje. Możesz po prostu zabrać go na swój statek i odlecieć.

To wszystko sprawia, że świat wygląda bardziej jak zbiór scenariuszy przygotowanych specjalnie dla gracza niż żywe miejsce, w którym faktycznie coś się dzieje.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]I mimo wszystko… polecam[/h2]

[i]Ostranauts[/i] ma [b]bardzo dużo niedociągnięć[/b]. I mimo całej tej krytyki [b]polecam grę[/b].

Nie widziałem jeszcze całej zawartości gry - nie dotarłem do eksploracji planet, asteroid miningu ani części endgame'u, więc nie będę udawał, że oceniam całość.

Przez [b]41 godzin[/b], które w niej spędziłem, byłem naprawdę pochłonięty. Jest tutaj sporo rzeczy do robienia, a samo budowanie, ulepszanie i kombinowanie ze statkiem potrafi dać mnóstwo satysfakcji.

Uważam jednak, że obecny poziom ukończenia wskazuje bardziej na [b]bardzo dobry Early Access niż na finalny produkt[/b].

Dałbym tej grze jeszcze rok albo dwa rozwoju. Będę śledził newsy i czekał na duży update.

[b]Na ten moment: polecam, ale z zastrzeżeniami.[/b]
items.text_zh:
[h1]Ostranauts——一副出色的骨架，却仍在等待真正的游戏[/h1]

游戏以高度模拟和有趣的太空飞船建造方式为诱饵。但它真的兑现了这些承诺吗？

[b]某种程度上是的。[/b]

你可以花很多小时寻找值得搜刮的残骸、出售部件，只为凑够抵押贷款，而当你已经有点钱时——就用来升级自己的飞船。这时我们会造出一个由数十艘其他飞船拼凑而成的不伦不类的混合体。

一路上我们会做些小小的侦探调查，直到最终到达可以高利润倒卖废墟的阶段。如果我们足够努力，甚至还能给自己的聚变反应堆找到一席之地。

而且必须承认——[b]做这件事本身相当有趣。[/b]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]问题始于我们做完本该做的事之后[/h2]

[b]为了什么？[/b]

这就是我对这款游戏最大的痛点。[i]Ostranauts[/i]只是一个非常好的太空模拟骨架，但我感觉这个骨架上仍然缺少真正的游戏。

你装好了反应堆，解锁了行星际旅行？不错。但究竟为什么要去其他行星？旅程要花很长时间，你不知道那里会遇到什么，必须提前准备好合适的舱室和补给，而最终那里大概也不会有什么突破性的东西等着你。

社交互动相当糟糕。如果你想让某人成为你的朋友，基本上只要跟他聊得足够久就行。而当你们已经是朋友之后——然后呢？没什么特别的。也许招募他会稍微容易一点之类的，但关于船员的事待会儿再说。

你升级了飞船，有了不错的引擎和大量燃料，所以你可以航行得更远。可那又怎样？你不会遇到更好的残骸，也不会遇到特别有趣的障碍。

[hr][/hr]

[h2]海盗与后果（或者说根本没有后果）[/h2]

有时在残骸上会遇到海盗。顺带一提，一个海盗孤零零地坐在残骸上，没有自己的飞船停靠在那里，这引出一个问题：

[b]他到底在那儿干什么？[/b]

这样的海盗可以毫无困难地干掉。但假设我们的角色不是杀人机器，我们想饶他一命。你把他打晕并带回自己的飞船。过了一会儿，这家伙站起来，尽管手无寸铁，却扑向你，要你交出财物。

那么对付海盗的选项是什么？

[b]把他们射进宇宙深渊。[/b]

我们的角色当然丝毫不会因为夺走他人性命而遭受创伤。

也可以招募船员，但指挥一个角色就已经够笨拙了，而更大的船员队伍非常昂贵——无论是游戏里的钱，还是你的电脑。

[hr][/hr]

[h2]性能[/h2]

[b]我的天。[/b]

这游戏是单线程运行的吗，还是怎么回事？

假设你停靠在一艘中等大小的残骸上。首先你下令让你的小人拆掉20面墙和地板。你开启x16速度。有时会卡一下，但勉强还能进行。

然后你下令在自己的飞船上建造一个新房间。你铺开地板网格，在四周竖起墙壁。

[b]然后就完了。[/b]

我不知道物品运送逻辑是否检查了你飞船和残骸的每一个格子，但墙壁有时慢得不真实。如果你想铺20块地板，看起来就像所有格子都被检查了20遍，而当游戏终于把所有东西处理完时，突然就OK了。

而我们说的
这里说的是4×5的房间。如果有人想建造一个20×10的房间，会发生什么？

再加上漫长的加载时间和愚蠢的AI。你需要五个相同的物品？角色宁愿跑五趟单独的来回，也不愿一次拿起整叠五个。

[hr][/hr]

[h2]世界[/h2]

不幸的是，这个世界也非常空旷，给人一种模型布景的感觉。

在空间站里，你永远是唯一停靠的飞船。你永远不会看到NPC飞来、停靠或飞走。如果你靠近一个NPC已经停靠的残骸，那个NPC确实会在那里——但什么也不做。

所以你可以直接洗劫残骸，而它甚至不会注意到你。

更妙的是，当你飞到海盗的地盘，拆下对那里反应堆至关重要的组件时。没有人会做出反应。你可以直接把它搬上自己的飞船然后飞走。

这一切让这个世界看起来更像是一堆专门为玩家准备的场景集合，而不是一个真正有事情发生的活生生的地方。

[hr][/hr]

[h2]尽管如此……我还是推荐[/h2]

[i]Ostranauts[/i]有[b]非常多的不足之处[/b]。尽管有这么多批评，[b]我还是推荐这款游戏[/b]。

我还没有看完游戏的全部内容——我还没到行星探索、小行星采矿或终局部分，所以我不会假装自己在评价整体。

在我投入的[b]41个小时[/b]里，我真的非常投入。这里有很多事情可做，光是建造、升级和折腾飞船就能带来极大的满足感。

不过我认为，目前的完成度更像是一个[b]非常优秀的抢先体验版，而不是最终成品[/b]。

我会再给这款游戏一到两年的开发时间。我会关注新闻，等待大型更新。

[b]目前来说：推荐，但有保留意见。[/b]

The concept of the game is really interesting and fun, its like star sector meets the sims.

However the game is too much of a mess for me to recommend, I had to reload the game several times due to patrol ships crashing into me at 400m/s because they don't know how to safely dock and just keep accelerating. The performance isn't great either, the game freezes every time it saves, when a character is looking for parts to fix a component with it lags for each part etc.

items.text:
One of my biggest discoveries this year. Same dev as Neo Scavenger, so expect an incredible atmosphere, god-tier writing, and an unforgiving yet incredibly satisfying gameplay loop.

You start as a shipbreaker trying to escape an inhumane, dead-end job that barely pays enough to survive. You take out a massive loan and buy what is basically a flying coffin that's falling apart before your eyes, all so you can finally start making your own choices in the harsh, unforgiving reality of the OKLG.

I still remember the first time I sold a big haul. After one crazy expedition that I somehow survived in one piece, I made more money than I had earned after years of grinding, sacrificing, and saving every dollar while working as another disposable megacorp employee. There's something incredibly compelling—almost relatable—about that feeling.

It's a space sim where you go from absolutely nothing to... maybe not a millionaire, but someone who took control of their own life and built the future they wanted. All of this takes place in a dystopian world where humanity has colonized the Solar System while simultaneously losing contact with Earth (Kessler Syndrome).

This is the good part—actually, the great part.

But then there's the second part.

I would summarize it in one sentence:

Lots of small, medium, big, or just game-breaking problems have been reported over the years, and they're still in the game. The devs know about them very well.

So what do they do?

Yep. They decide to ship 1.0 next month.

As a software engineer myself, it's just painful to watch.

Here's a short list of those problems:

- CTDs.
- Insane loading times (partially fixable with Nexus mods).
- Broken quests (people on Steam and Discord literally recommend not engaging with them).
- A UI that feels like it was designed to make you suffer.
- The game clearly wasn't designed around controlling more than one character, yet it pushes you hard to hire a crew. The AI is from hell, the UI somehow gets even worse, and this introduces all sorts of problems the devs simply didn't think through. The absolute king is below:
- And the worst part: horrible performance. At some point (mid to late game), it becomes literally unplayable. I'm not talking about the usual stuttering that's already everywhere. I'm talking about one frame every three seconds. Yes—0.33 FPS. Performance is such a well-known issue that it even has its own thread on official Discord server. You can reproduce it very easily: just queue around 20 commands (for example, dismantling ship hull walls) while having 4 or more NPCs. The lag persists even after cancelling those commands. Good luck saving the game or reloading it while running at one frame every three seconds. Kekw's on you.

Now look at this list of problems and ask yourself:

"Why. instead of fixing above. the devs are shipping new features that introduce even more bugs, and then set 1.0 release date for next month?"

¯\_(ツ)_/¯

If you still want to play it, here's one pro tip:

Don't hire NPCs. The game was clearly designed around playing a single character. You'll have a lot more fun that way, while minimizing negative-fun you are getting. Trust.
items.text_zh:
这是我今年最大的发现之一。和《Neo Scavenger》是同一个开发者，所以可以期待令人难以置信的氛围、神级的写作，以及一个毫不留情却又极其令人满足的游戏循环。

你一开始是一名拆船工，试图逃离一份不人道、没有前途、几乎不够糊口的工作。你贷了一大笔款，买了一艘基本上就是会飞的棺材、在你眼前分崩离析的船，只为了终于能在OKLG严酷无情的现实中开始做出自己的选择。

我仍然记得第一次卖掉一大批货物的时候。在一次我不知怎么毫发无伤地活下来的疯狂远征之后，我赚到的钱比我作为又一个可随意丢弃的巨型企业员工，多年苦熬、牺牲、省下每一块钱所赚到的还要多。那种感觉有一种难以置信的吸引力——几乎让人感同身受。

这是一款太空模拟游戏，你从一无所有到……也许不是百万富翁，但成为一个掌控了自己人生、建立了自己想要未来的人。这一切都发生在一个反乌托邦世界里，人类已经殖民了太阳系，同时却与地球失去了联系（凯斯勒综合征）。

这是好的部分——其实，是极好的部分。

但接着还有第二部分。

我会用一句话来总结：

多年来人们报告了大量小的、中等的、大的，或者干脆就是破坏游戏的问题，而它们仍然留在游戏里。开发者们对此非常清楚。

那他们怎么做？

没错。他们决定下个月发布1.0。

作为一名软件工程师，看着实在令人痛苦。

以下是这些问题的一小部分清单：

- 崩溃到桌面。
- 疯狂的加载时间（用Nexus的模组可以部分修复）。
- 损坏的任务（Steam和Discord上的人真的建议不要碰它们）。
- 一个感觉像是专门设计来让你受罪的UI。
- 这款游戏显然不是围绕控制多个角色设计的，却硬是逼着你雇佣船员。AI来自地狱，UI不知怎么变得更糟，还引入了开发者根本没想清楚的各种问题。绝对的王者在下面：

items.text:
[b]Ostranauts is a good game but it comes with some very real flaws.[/b]
There’s something deeply satisfying about drifting through a space scrapyard, carefully dismantling derelict ships piece by piece, repairing components, and selling them for profit. The salvage loop is addictive. Strip a wreck, haul the parts, patch up what you can, flip it for cash, and repeat. If that core gameplay loop clicks with you, it REALLY clicks.
Personally, I had a lot of fun. The issues didn’t bother me enough to ruin the experience. However, many negative reviews focus on the following problems (and they’re not wrong):

1. There is a recurring slowdown bug where the game noticeably lags every now and then; search for "stuttering". It’s especially frustrating on older machines. On top of that, load and save times are inexplicably slow. 
2. The UI is horible, sorry to be blunt. Control windows take up two-thirds of the screen for no clear reason. Many actions require excessive clicking. Installing and dismantling or repairing items are buried in separate menus with their own submenus. It feels like a design straight out of the late 1990s.
In a game this complex, usability matters.  That’s difficult to justify in 2026.
3. The AI is not strong: even simple actions require heavy micromanagement. I hired a crew member to assist with scavenging and ended up firing her because:
- She did almost nothing useful.
- She somehow got fined for reasons I still don’t understand.
- Managing her required more effort than doing the work myself.
After firing her, she refused to leave my ship despite repeated orders. I eventually had to dismantle the chair under her just to make her move and offboard (!). That should not be a solution.
There are more examples, but the pattern is consistent: crew management currently feels more like babysitting than delegation.
4. On a similar side, character interaction feels sterile and mechanically shallow. The GUI makes it even harder to manage conversations and relationships smoothly. The RPG layer (quests, social systems, etc) is superficial. It works for the first hour or so, but after that I skipped quests entirely. The salvage gameplay loop is far stronger than the narrative systems right now.
5. Ship Planner is outisde the game?!?! The ship planner being external to the game is baffling. It’s clearly still in alpha and not particularly user-friendly. For most in-game purposes, it’s barely helpful.
What’s needed is something integrated and intuitive i.e closer to the planning systems in Prison Architect. As it stands, it is completely disconnected from actual gameplay.
6. The economy is poorly balanced: after just a few hours and two or three scrapyard trips, money stops being an issue entirely. I’m currently sitting on 9 million space dollars. There’s no real financial pressure once you understand the salvage loop.
For example, I rebuilt a tiny 50k derelict wiht no functional engine into a full-fledged space cruiser with a fusion reactor, seven hydrogen tanks, and enough thrust for 3G acceleration. Final value: 3 million. That progression feels great, but the economic curve flattens far too quickly.

The Good News: the developer clearly tapped into something special... The game is actively maintained — 35 patches in the last year alone, including 7 major ones. More content is on the way (though the upcoming space combat patch is raising some eyebrows). There’s variety, depth in the salvage mechanics, and a genuinely compelling systems-driven core.
If the developer addresses even a couple of the major issues listed above, this could easily become a game that provides dozens, if not hundreds, of hours of entertainment.
Already now, it’s a flawed but very enjoyable experience.
That's why it gets my thumbs up.

[b]Ostranauts是一款好游戏，但它也带有一些非常真实的缺陷。[/b]
在太空废料场中漂移，仔细地一艘艘拆解废弃飞船，修理部件，然后卖掉它们获利，这其中有一种深深的满足感。打捞循环令人上瘾。拆解一艘残骸，拖运零件，能修的就修，转手换钱，然后重复。如果这个核心玩法循环对你来说对味，那它真的非常对味。
就个人而言，我玩得非常开心。这些问题并没有烦扰我到毁掉体验的程度。然而，许多负面评测都集中在以下问题上（而且他们说得没错）：

1. 存在一个反复出现的减速bug，游戏时不时会明显卡顿；搜索“stuttering”就能看到。在较老的机器上尤其令人沮丧。除此之外，加载和保存时间也慢得莫名其妙。
2. UI很糟糕，抱歉说得这么直白。控制窗口毫无明确理由地占据屏幕三分之二。许多操作需要过度点击。安装、拆解或修理物品被埋在各自带有子菜单的独立菜单里。感觉就像是直接从20世纪90年代末搬出来的设计。
在一款如此复杂的游戏里，可用性很重要。这在2026年很难说得过去。
3. AI不强：即便是简单的行动也需要大量微操。我雇了一名船员来协助拾荒，最后却把她解雇了，因为：
- 她几乎没做什么有用的事。
- 她不知怎么就被罚款了，原因我至今都不明白。
- 管理她比我自己干活还要费劲。
解雇她之后，尽管我反复下令，她还是拒绝离开我的飞船。我最后不得不拆掉她坐着的椅子，才让她动起来并离船（！）。这不该成为解决办法。
还有更多例子，但模式是一致的：目前船员管理感觉更像是当保姆，而不是委派任务。
4. 类似地，角色互动感觉冷冰冰的，机制上也很浅薄。GUI让顺畅管理对话和关系变得更加困难。RPG层面（任务、社交系统等）很表面。头一个小时左右还行，但之后我就完全跳过任务了。目前打捞玩法循环远比叙事系统强大。
5. 飞船规划器竟然在游戏之外？！？！飞船规划器独立于游戏之外，这令人费解。它显然仍处于alpha阶段，而且并不是特别用户友好。对大多数游戏内用途来说，它几乎没什么帮助。
需要的是某种集成且直观的东西，也就是更接近《监狱建筑师》里的规划系统。就目前而言，它与实际玩法完全脱节。
6. 经济平衡很差：仅仅几个小时后，跑了两三趟废料场，钱就完全不再是问题了。我目前坐拥900万太空美元。一旦你理解了打捞循环，就不存在真正的财务压力。
例如，我把一艘5万、没有可用引擎的小型残骸重建为一艘完整的太空巡洋舰，配有聚变反应堆、七个氢罐，以及足以进行3G加速的推力。最终价值：300万。这种成长感觉很棒，但经济曲线太平得太快了。

好消息：开发者显然触及到了某种特别的东西……游戏正在积极维护——仅去年就有35个补丁，其中包括7个大型补丁。更多内容正在路上（尽管即将到来的太空战斗补丁让一些人扬起了眉毛）。打捞机制有变化、有深度，还有一个真正引人入胜的、由系统驱动的核心。
如果开发者哪怕只解决上面列出的几个主要问题，这也很容易成为一款能提供数十甚至数百小时娱乐的游戏。
即便现在，它也是一款有缺陷但非常令人愉快的体验。
这就是为什么它得到了我的点赞。

NOT playable without extreme frustration. time-waste, UI fatigue, and outright game-breaking problems right now.  As of now, I've thrown up my hands and given up on trying to get this to work.  70-80% of my gameplay time was spent fighting with an extremely user-hostile UI, whether in terms of inventory management or of trying to keep my crewmembers' psychology from constantly, rapidly degrading by extended periods of micromanaged abstract social interaction.

There are some very, very serious flaws in this game that make it almost-unplayable right now and have to be fixed very badly, even for the standards of early access.  I will check out the game later and hope the developer will address them decisively.  For now, though, my recommendation remains an unqualified, resounding NO for everyone.

(1) Dollies and other containers need to be able to be picked up ALWAYS.  I should never have to spend 30 minutes trying to figure out how to get around the "Can't get to The Tetsudo 'SuperHandy' Equipment truck" when my guy is standing right, next, to, it.  This happens constantly and is a major detractor, and on top of that is so unnecessary.  I don't care how many items are piled in that space.  If you make it possible, make it workable.  Fix it, right away.  It's a serious downer.

(2) I really need my guy to STOP walking away on his own when I'm trying to do something.  Doesn't matter what shift, but even on work shift he's constantly, walking, away.  I don't need to constantly herd ADD cats or micromanage their attention.  And never mind crewmembers.  AI behavior should only engage when it's set to AI.  Otherwise I don't want to be constantly fighting the insistent AI for control of my guys.  It's very frustrating and destroys enjoyment.  Fix this.

(3) Crewmember hyper-sensitivity (and inclination to quit) should be turned off until AI is more reliable.  I don't need to be rescuing my non-EVA-suited member from asphyxiation as they inexplicably leave the station to sit in the middle of my atmospherically-compromised beginning ship and then seeing this hit their Autonomy, after which I tediously have to complain about authorities over and over with them to get their Autonomy up, all while fighting their constantly walking away or doing other things and having to wait for them to randomly write a letter home.  Oh, and two other people coming and interrupting and having to wait for that to finish.  This is not gameplay; this is punishment, and it's excrutiating.

I get that you're trying to introduce an awareness and mechanical relevance of the non-instrumentality and needs of human beings as crew, for the respect of labor and its relationship to its employers, and that is laudable for sure, but it is pretty damned punishing and tedious right now.

As I write this, I watched my crewmember's Autonomy drop from green to Opprressed in a matter of minutes.  Wtf?  He'll quit momentarily no doubt, even though he's basically just come off of a two-day break after a day of work.  Guess I shouid just consider crewmembers untenable at this stage of development.

REMOVE this until it can work reasonably.  OR give an easily-accessible debug reset of crewmembers' psych condition so we don't have to spend 50% of playtime fighting with it.

4) Animation-locking for UI elements (like navigation console) and opening inventory on items MUST go.  It's a cardinal sin in a game with this much tedious micro to have every step be locked down in 2-3-second delays by animations no doubt intended to be immersive, but resulting in incrementing UI fatigue.  It's far worse when you have to wait to get in control of the ship because of some UI gaffe.  Don't make me "cancel" the "action" of not-doing-an-action so I can do the action.  (Yes, there's literally a timed, animation-locking action that characters frequently do that is "wait for..." -- a non-action that has to be manually canceled.) 
 Get rid of this.

Other significant but not-as-urgent problems:

1) Loading/saving (and pretty much everything else) needs to permit alt-tab out so we don't have to sit there staring at a load screen that takes 20 seconds before we even see a gameplay tip.


2) Default command keys are bizarre.  Tab should be switching between crew.  CAPS LOCK is a strange choice.  By virtue of the soul-crushing tendency of crewmembers to do stupid ♥♥♥♥ when they shouldn't, I have to switch between crewmembers a LOT to keep them on track; it should have the more conventional switch key.

3) Pressing TAB to switch between characters causes LOADING SHIP on-screen display and 2-3-second delay even if they're on the same ship, right next to each other.

TL:DR: Just read the top two paragraphs.

Note to dev: The real sin in a lot of this is you canNOT force-implement non-working systems.  If the psychology/morale system doesn't work sufficiently to be reasonably playable, either leave it turned off until you have developed it sufficiently, or allow players to disable it.  This was the straw that broke the camel's back for me.

EDIT 2025-05-24: I see the dev is pushing out updates, and that's an encouraging site.  Just waiting for an excuse to turn this review positive -- I do love a lot of what's trying to be done here and will be watching and waiting.

没有极度的挫败感就玩不下去。浪费时间、UI疲劳，而且眼下还有彻底破坏游戏的问题。就目前而言，我已经举手投降，放弃让它正常运转的尝试了。我70-80%的游戏时间都花在和一个极度不友好的UI作斗争上，无论是在库存管理方面，还是在试图通过长时间微观管理的抽象社交互动来防止我的船员心理不断、迅速地恶化方面。

这款游戏有一些非常、非常严重的缺陷，使其现在几乎无法游玩，而且必须非常迫切地修复，即使以抢先体验的标准来看也是如此。我以后会再看看这款游戏，并希望开发者能果断地解决这些问题。不过就目前而言，我的推荐仍然是对所有人毫无保留、响亮的“不”。

(1) 手推车和其他容器必须始终能够被拾取。我绝不应该花30分钟试图弄清楚如何绕过“无法到达Tetsudo‘SuperHandy’设备卡车”，而我的角色就站在它正、旁、边。这种情况不断发生，是一个主要的减分项，而且除此之外还完全没有必要。我不在乎那个空间里堆了多少物品。如果你让它成为可能，就让它可用。马上修好它。这非常令人扫兴。

(2) 我真的很需要我的角色在我试图做某事时停止自行走开。不管是什么班次，但即使在工作班次，他也一直在走开。我不需要不断驱赶患有注意力缺陷多动障碍的猫，也不需要微观管理它们的注意力。更不用说船员了。AI行为应该只在设置为AI时才启用。否则我不想不断与固执的AI争夺对我角色的控制权。这非常令人沮丧，并破坏乐趣。修好这个。

(3) 在AI更可靠之前，应该关闭船员的过度敏感（以及辞职倾向）。我不需要去拯救我没穿EVA服的船员免于窒息，因为他们莫名其妙地离开空间站，坐在我那大气环境受损的初始飞船中间，然后看到这影响了他们的自主性，之后我又得乏味地一遍又一遍和他们抱怨当局来提高他们的自主性，同时还要对抗他们不断走开或做其他事情，并不得不等他们随机给家里写信。哦，还有另外两个人过来打断，还得等那结束。这不是游戏玩法；这是惩罚，而且令人痛苦不堪。

我明白你是在试图引入对人类作为船员所具有的非工具性和需求的意识与机制相关性，出于对劳动的尊重及其与雇主的关系，这当然值得称赞，但现在这实在太惩罚人、太乏味了。

在我写这段话时，我看着我的船员的自主性在几分钟内从绿色降到“受压迫”。搞什么？他毫无疑问马上就会辞职，尽管他基本上才刚在工作一天后休完两天假。看来在这个开发阶段，我就该把船员视为不可用。

在它能合理运作之前，移除这个。或者提供一个易于访问的调试重置船员心理状态的功能，这样我们就不必把50%的游戏时间花在与它作斗争上。

4) UI元素（如导航控制台）的动画锁定以及打开物品库存的动画锁定必须取消。在一款有这么多乏味微观管理的游戏里，让每一步都被2-3秒的延迟锁住，是弥天大罪。
毫无疑问，这些动画本意是营造沉浸感，但结果却不断累积UI疲劳。当你因为某些UI失误而不得不等待才能控制飞船时，情况就更糟了。别让我为了做一个动作而不得不“取消”那个“不做动作”的“动作”。（是的，字面意义上存在一个定时的、锁定动画的动作，角色经常做，叫做“等待……”——一个必须手动取消的非动作。）
把这种东西去掉。

其他重要但没那么紧急的问题：

1）加载/保存（以及几乎所有其他操作）需要允许alt-tab切出，这样我们就不必坐在那里盯着一个要花20秒才显示游戏提示的加载画面。


2）默认命令键很奇怪。Tab应该用来在船员之间切换。CAPS LOCK是个奇怪的选择。由于船员们有一种令人心力交瘁的倾向，会在不该做蠢事的时候做蠢事，我不得不非常频繁地在船员之间切换以让他们保持正轨；它应该用更常规的切换键。

3）按TAB在角色之间切换会导致屏幕上显示LOADING SHIP并出现2-3秒的延迟，即使他们在同一艘飞船上，就紧挨着彼此。

TL:DR：只读前两段就行。

给开发者的备注：这其中很多问题的真正罪过在于，你绝不能强行实装不能正常运作的系统。如果心理/士气系统运作得不够好，无法合理可玩，要么在充分开发之前把它关掉，要么允许玩家禁用它。这就是压垮我的最后一根稻草。

编辑 2025-05-24：我看到开发者正在推送更新，这是个令人鼓舞的景象。只是在等一个把这条评测改成好评的借口——我确实很喜欢这里尝试做的很多事，会持续关注和等待。

Still extremely buggy, buying a second ship and ferrying off the station to the new ship will softlock the current station due to only one docking port if you haven't sold the old one in hopes of transporting things from one ship to the other.

Multiple crew will bug out when swapping between floors, sometimes not loading the selected crew member or the ship will just not be loaded in, completely defeats the point of having an entire crew when you can't even get them all on the same map to hop on the ship together.

That assumes you can actually hire crew, because people are unable to talk and do a task at the same time, and NPCs will actively walk off mid conversation because they recalled some random task they needed to do when being offered a job. You will have to chase them through multiple loading screens because they can just choose to go to a different zone.

Massive issues requiring debug workarounds, enough that teleporting between stations to fix the amount of issues you run into becomes common. NPCs don't respect station proximity with numerous reports on the reddit of them going 500m/s into docking because they don't require much slowing down and have no concern for the player among other issues.

I wish I could love the game like I did NeoScavenger, but they are talking about 1.0 release in the next year when they can't even load multiple areas at once which is likely causing half of the loading issues for multiple crew on the same station.
If you are going to force me to sit through 5-10 seconds of lag for each zone switch, you might as well just load all the areas I've switched to that have active crew, at least then you are less likely to have loading issues.

The game fails to explain the only properly implemented content is the white location diamonds, mentioned only in the patch notes as far as I can find, meaning only two locations have been implemented in the long duration so far, with the medical center in Venus Orbital still having the OKLG dialogue.
This made it nearly impossible for me to figure out if there was a second ship selling location so I could fix the starter ship occupying the main dock of the starting location.


I love the ship building, I love how detailed and alive the menus can feel with graffiti, I love how involved the wiring and reactors can be, I like that each character has a variety of needs beyond the few basic survival ones food/water/sleep. The whole game has more bite than any of the simplistic survival ship builder games out there, more personality.

All in all, I wish I could love the game, I want to build fun ships, I want to run a crew and scavenge a bunch of wrecks, I want to learn about the game and it's lore following NeoScavenger, I've come back every few months for the last four years, but every time I've run into fatal bugs, issues, game breaks that make the whole thing unplayable or breaks the pacing for all engagement I had with it.
It's a work in progress, take that as you will, but it isn't in my recommended list as of yet.

仍然有极其严重的bug，买第二艘船并把空间站上的东西运到新船上会导致当前空间站软锁，因为如果你还没卖掉旧船、希望把东西从一艘船运到另一艘船，那就只有一个对接端口。

多名船员在楼层之间切换时会出bug，有时不会加载选中的船员，或者飞船干脆不加载进来，这完全违背了拥有整支船员队伍的意义，因为你甚至无法让他们全部出现在同一张地图上一起登船。

这还是假设你真的能雇到船员，因为人们无法同时说话和做任务，而且NPC会在对话中途直接走开，因为他们在被提供工作时想起了某个随机任务需要去做。你将不得不追着他们穿过多个加载画面，因为他们可以直接选择去另一个区域。

大量问题需要调试变通手段，多到在空间站之间传送来修复你遇到的一堆问题已经变得很常见。NPC不遵守空间站邻近规则，reddit上有大量报告说他们以500m/s的速度冲进对接，因为他们不需要怎么减速，也完全不顾玩家，此外还有其他问题。

我真希望能像爱NeoScavenger那样爱这款游戏，但他们说要在明年发布1.0，而他们甚至无法同时加载多个区域，这很可能就是同一空间站上多名船员一半加载问题的原因。
如果你要强迫我每次切换区域都忍受5到10秒的卡顿，那你不如直接加载我切换过的所有有活跃船员的区域，至少那样你更不容易出现加载问题。

游戏没有解释唯一真正实现的内容是白色地点菱形，据我所找到的，它们只在补丁说明里被提到过，这意味着在这么长的时间里只实现了两个地点，而金星轨道上的医疗中心仍然有OKLG对话。
这让我几乎不可能弄清楚是否有第二个卖船地点，好让我修好那艘占据起始地点主对接港的初始飞船。


我喜欢造船，我喜欢菜单能通过涂鸦显得如此细致而鲜活，我喜欢布线和反应堆能如此复杂，我喜欢每个角色除了食物/水/睡眠这几个基本生存需求之外还有各种各样的需求。整个游戏比市面上任何简化的生存造船游戏都更有锋芒，更有性格。

总而言之，我真希望能爱这款游戏，我想造有趣的飞船，我想经营一支船员队伍并打捞一堆残骸，我想了解这款游戏以及它继NeoScavenger之后的背景设定，过去四年里我每隔几个月就会回来一次，但每次我都会遇到致命bug、问题、游戏崩溃，让整个游戏无法游玩，或者破坏我原本投入的所有节奏。
它还在开发中，你爱怎么理解就怎么理解，但到目前为止它不在我的推荐列表里。

>>> TLDR: This is a comprehensive set of systems to simulate space-scrapper's life with very little motivation to actually do it. It's also extremely clunky, filled with questionable mechanics and technical solutions, with a lot of esoteric systems that either need a Wiki open or make no sense regardless. This game has huge playability issues and Steam achievements' percentages reflect it justfully <<<

**Review after 1.0**
Thankfully, they improved technical state of the game. There are less bugs, the game stores its save files in the memory to minimize disk access times, game stutters way less, etc. However, player experience is still absolutely horrible (which is confirmed by achievements percentages). UI is awful (you can't even leave character creation menu), auto-tasking doesn't work properly half of the time, hauling is laughably inefficient (you haul one item at a time regardless of your inventory space and there is no *reasonable* item filtering system), pathfinding still completely fails beyond certain distance, controlling multiple characters is still a chore, super fast forward is better but still unreliable.

The worst thing about this game is badly designed game loop. It's more of a "game half-circle". You start with a debt, you can completely cover it in 3-5 game days and then money loose most of their value. Sure, you can buy some expensive real estate, but what's the point of this if your real estate is already docked to the station? Sure, you can buy some ship components from a vendor, but what's the point of this if the stock is random and the amount of hull parts is minuscule? Okay, instead of selling the components you can expand your ship. Cool. But it quickly hits practical limit and becomes purely an aesthetical activity (which is discouraging, because the process is very tedious and involves a lot of idle waiting). You can trade. Okay, but money don't really matter. You can flip ships. Nice, but there's not many uses for money. You can do high-paying missions. But they're repetitive and money aren't needed. In short, a lot of the game revolves around earning money, but money have almost no value past the very start of the game. Mods partially alleviate some of the issues but they can't fix game's core.



**Previous pre-release review** 
Don't look at my hour counter please, I played well over 100 hours of this game.
Overall, it's a great framework with functional simulations of a space scrapper's life and hazards. It needs more content, but mechanics are very solid, if a little bit intimidating to learn at first. And developer promised more content to come, so it's all good.

However. On the technical side game has multiple issues that are mainly the reason why this review is negative, unfortunately. 
- First of all, performance. Large ships lag a lot. Large amounts of NPCs lag a lot. The older the save, the more laggy it becomes. You *have* to use dev tools to debloat your save from time to time to keep game's performance adequate.
- Pathfinding. NPCs can't pathfind very well and can't pathfind at all beyond certain distance. Pathfinding between two ships can also be a challenge depending on both ships' sizes. This makes managing a crew or bulding up your ship a chore. You have to babysit crewmates at all times and make sure nobody is idling.
- Saves. This game juggles around a lot of data. It stores everything in JSON format, creating a separate file for every "ship" entity in the game, and packs each save in it's own archive. Due to how fractured saves are, they take a while to pack and unpack, which makes loading and saving the game take a while, even on a SSD. The game also doesn't save in a "quick" way, each save it goes over every single bit of data and creates new archive. It's taxing not only on player's time, but also on SSD's health. Game also allows a lot of garbage to accumulate on an older save, which includes all of the ships that flew outside of NPC salvagers' range of operations. On older save there could be dozens of pirate vessels drifting away to outer space which game has to account for. 
- Bugs. Every patch a lot of bugs get ironed out, yes, but there are still a lot of them present and very apparent. Ships can get stuck, NPCs can go to 4th dimension, constantly trying to pathfind out of it and eating away at performance, UI can break, shifts can break, super fast forward is unpredictable and unreliable, quests can break, etc.

If you can ignore all of the aforementioned issues, you can get a lot of fun out of Ostranauts. But I really want the developers to go over technical side of the game, because it's the weakest and the most crucial part of the experience in my opinion.
items.text_zh:
>>> 太长不看：这是一套全面的系统，用来模拟太空拾荒者的生活，但几乎没有真正去做的动力。它还极其笨拙，充斥着可疑的机制和技术方案，有大量晦涩难懂的系统，要么需要开着 Wiki，要么无论如何都说不通。这款游戏有巨大的可玩性问题，Steam 成就的百分比公正地反映了这一点 <<<

**1.0 之后的评测**
谢天谢地，他们改善了游戏的技术状态。Bug 更少了，游戏把存档文件存在内存中以尽量减少磁盘访问时间，游戏卡顿少多了，等等。然而，玩家体验仍然绝对糟糕（成就百分比证实了这一点）。UI 很糟糕（你甚至无法离开角色创建菜单），自动任务有一半时间不能正常工作，搬运效率低得可笑（无论你的库存空间有多大，你一次只能搬一件物品，而且没有*合理的*物品过滤系统），寻路在超过一定距离后仍然完全失效，控制多个角色仍然是一件苦差事，超级快进更好了但仍然不可靠。

这款游戏最糟糕的地方是设计糟糕的游戏循环。它更像是一个“游戏半圆”。你一开始背负债务，可以在 3-5 个游戏日内完全还清，然后钱就失去了大部分价值。当然，你可以买一些昂贵的房地产，但如果你的房地产已经停靠在空间站上，这又有什么意义呢？当然，你可以从供应商那里买一些飞船部件，但如果库存是随机的，而且船体部件的数量少得可怜，这又有什么意义呢？好吧，与其卖掉部件，你可以扩建你的飞船。很酷。但它很快就会触及实际限制，变成纯粹的美学活动（这令人沮丧，因为过程非常繁琐，涉及大量空闲等待）。你可以贸易。好吧，但钱并不真的重要。你可以倒卖飞船。不错，但钱没有多少用处。你可以做高报酬的任务。但它们重复性高，而且不需要钱。简而言之，游戏的大部分内容都围绕着赚钱，但在游戏刚开始之后，钱几乎没有任何价值。Mod 部分缓解了一些问题，但无法修复游戏的核心。



**之前的抢先体验评测**
请不要看我的小时数，我玩这款游戏远远超过 100 小时。
总体而言，这是一个很棒的框架，功能性地模拟了太空拾荒者的生活和危险。它需要更多内容，但机制非常扎实，尽管一开始学习起来有点吓人。而且开发者承诺会有更多内容，所以一切都好。

然而。在技术方面，游戏有多个问题，不幸的是，这些主要是这篇评测为负面的原因。
- 首先是性能。大型飞船会严重卡顿。大量 NPC 会严重卡顿。存档越旧，就越卡。你*必须*时不时使用开发者工具来精简你的存档，以保持游戏性能足够。
- 寻路。NPC 寻路能力很差，超过一定距离就完全无法寻路。根据两艘飞船的大小，在两艘飞船之间寻路也可能是个挑战。这使得管理船员或建造飞船成为一件苦差事。你必须时刻照看船员，确保没人在闲置。
- 存档。这款游戏要处理大量数据。它以 JSON 格式存储所有内容，为游戏中的每个“飞船”实体创建一个单独的文件，并将每个存档打包
放在它自己的存档里。由于存档碎片化严重，打包和解包需要一段时间，这使得加载和保存游戏都要花上一阵子，即使是在固态硬盘上也是如此。游戏也不是以“快速”方式保存的，每次保存都会遍历每一个数据位并创建新存档。这不仅消耗玩家的时间，也消耗固态硬盘的寿命。游戏还允许大量垃圾在旧存档中积累，其中包括所有飞出NPC打捞者作业范围之外的飞船。在旧存档中，可能有数十艘海盗船漂向外太空，而游戏必须对它们进行追踪处理。
- Bug。没错，每个补丁都会修掉很多bug，但仍然存在大量bug，而且非常明显。飞船可能卡住，NPC可能进入第四维度，不断尝试寻路脱离并消耗性能，UI可能崩溃，轮班可能崩溃，超级快进不可预测且不可靠，任务可能崩溃，等等。

如果你能忽略上述所有问题，你可以从《Ostranauts》中获得很多乐趣。但我真的希望开发者能好好处理游戏的技术层面，因为在我看来，这是整个体验中最薄弱、也最关键的部分。

If you can't stand buggy games, don't try this game, or EA releases in general. It is playable, but it will slowly break down. Every 1 in 10 station visits, my ship would disappear from the airlock, and the station's atmosphere would mysteriously vent into space, slowly killing all the essential NPCs inside.

But I only rate EA based on potential, and this has good potential.

Still, the game is quite unwieldy. That should be addressed right after making the game run smoother. I'm talking about the unintentionally unwieldy parts, btw.

Some of the game is intentionally unwieldy: flying your ship & managing ship systems in general. You're an unlicensed ship breaker working with nav systems and nuclear reactors (almost literally) made in China. To navigate from point to point, you need to get acquainted with a console with about 35 analog switches, mostly with brief labels like STN, BRY, BRG, & ANT, that require you to read a manual in-game to understand what each button does. It's not remotely difficult, but it is not as simple as right-click fast travel, or piloting a car in space. It may not sound like it, but it is quite fun, and could be the focus of a whole other game.

Some parts of the game are unintentionally unwieldy. For example, to designate floors for installation, you have to
(1) open your PDA
(2) open the Install app
(3) go to the Hull menu
(4) scroll until you find your floor tile (there's about 48 items in that menu, no search bar or categories)
(5) wiggle your cursor to every square you want floors installed to (there is no click-drag bounding box feature)
Did something interrupt you, or did you want to get a better look and have to close the menu? You need to repeat all that clicking to get the floor again.

To order a crew member to uninstall a wall-lamp, you have to:
(1) open your PDA
(2) open the Orders app
(3) untick the five other categories, only leaving POWER on, otherwise you might uninstall the floor on the same tile as the wall lamp
(4) click uninstall
(5) find the wall lamp in the world again, and left click it

As you can see, unwieldy.

IMO first priority should be to
(1) make saving and loading much much faster
(2) make loading from the menu possible
this is so we can quickly test the game and write quality bug reports, since the devs said that they are in the "hardening" phase of development
items.text_zh:
如果你受不了有bug的游戏，就别试这款游戏，或者别碰EA发行的一般作品。它是能玩的，但会慢慢崩坏。每10次到站访问中就有1次，我的飞船会从气闸处消失，空间站的大气会神秘地泄漏到太空中，慢慢杀死里面所有重要的NPC。

但我只根据潜力来评价EA，而这款游戏潜力不错。

不过，游戏还是相当笨重。这应该在让游戏运行更流畅之后马上解决。顺便说一句，我说的是那些非故意的笨重部分。

游戏有些部分是有意笨重的：驾驶飞船以及总体管理飞船系统。你是一个无证拆船工，操作着（几乎字面意义上）中国制造的导航系统和核反应堆。要从一个点导航到另一个点，你需要熟悉一个大约有35个模拟开关的控制台，大多数开关只有像STN、BRY、BRG和ANT这样的简短标签，需要你阅读游戏内手册才能理解每个按钮的作用。这远不算难，但也不像右键快速旅行或在太空中驾驶汽车那么简单。听起来可能不像，但这相当有趣，而且可以成为另一款完整游戏的核心。

游戏有些部分是非故意笨重的。例如，要指定安装地板的位置，你必须
(1) 打开你的PDA
(2) 打开Install应用
(3) 进入Hull菜单
(4) 滚动直到找到你的地板砖（那个菜单里大约有48个项目，没有搜索栏或分类）
(5) 把光标挪到每一个你想安装地板的方格上（没有点击拖拽的框选功能）
有事情打断你了吗，还是你想看得更清楚而不得不关闭菜单？你需要重复所有这些点击才能再次找到那块地板。

要命令一名船员卸下一盏壁灯，你必须：
(1) 打开你的PDA
(2) 打开Orders应用
(3) 取消勾选其他五个类别，只留下POWER，否则你可能会卸下与壁灯同一格的地板
(4) 点击卸载
(5) 在世界中再次找到那盏壁灯，然后左键点击它

如你所见，很笨重。

在我看来，首要任务应该是
(1) 让保存和加载快得多得多
(2) 让从菜单加载成为可能
这样我们就能快速测试游戏并写出高质量的bug报告，因为开发者说他们正处于开发的“加固”阶段

items.text:
Ostranauts is a top down 2d space scavenger game with ship building mechanics and a simple atmosphere and orbital dynamics simulator. It also looks like there is the intent to have heat simulation and some crew interaction simulation. There is a hypothetical long range travel,  but its bugged out of any usefulness and despite dozens of attempts I failed to make the autopilot get me anywhere near anywhere else. Note that you have to use the autopilot as you cannot manually use the long range drive. That the characters die unless you manually feed them every few hours also make long distance travel atrociously annoying. It would be so simple to have them auto consume food, water and sleep when fast forwarding, but instead they just randomly die. 

and cant really say anything about it. The main game loop consists of scavenging various derelicts and building up your ship, and paying of the loans you have on the starting ship, avoiding spending too much on fuel and oxygen. This aspect is somewhat fun, but the main difficulty of the game is essentially remembering where you stored something. This makes building and repair with spare parts tedious. It would be a good idea to keep track of only a few kinds of mechanically different floors, and keep the texture of the floor separate from the type, and the same holds for walls. The shipbuilding is fun but due to storage mechanics rather tedious. The power mechanics are very opaque and there is no way to see how much something will draw. There is a system for character progression, well maybe, it still levels up the skills you already have, and when they finally reach 100% you never get anything for it, but it does look like its there... The amount of work needed is also wildly varying and disproportionate. Combat and conversation is lousy, again mostly due to bad ui. It would be better if you entered into a  different kind of menu for it, rather than needing to scroll around and guess what things do. 

There should also be difficulty related to managing food, drink and atmosphere and heat, but these systems are nearly trivial to maintain, or bugged. There is also no recycling of food drink wast etc, no greenhouses, and strangely no solar panels or radio isotope generators. The occasional loss of power, or fuel, or crashing nav station are all fun things mini events but can be a bit too punishing in some cases. 

There is an interesting character creation process, but its rather limited, and without knowing what anything does its less fun. 

The problem is the bugs. Bugs like your character equiping a space helmet for no clear reason and then falling unconsious once the air runs out while inside your ship where the atmosphere is fine. Bugs like the various character status bars being difficult to intrepet, or again bugged. Bugs like not needing to go to the bathroom for months before suddenly nearly dying due to not having been in the last few minutes over and over again. Bugs like station personel dropping like flies if you stick around for a few hours, leaving their valuables behind.  Bugs like losing the ability to left click on things, which is the main mode of interaction, bugs like the character randomly committing suicide in various ways. The game is also astonishingly slow to load and save which is the only way to fix most bugs. Please upgrade to protobufs with an arena and stop using zipped jsons... Also the game badly needs longer range for a* when searching for valid paths and valid haul locations. 

The game is really promising, but just not ready for release yet. If you are willing to live with alot of unintuitive ui, jank the game is fun as is, but it still needs alot of work.

《Ostranauts》是一款俯视视角的2D太空打捞游戏，带有飞船建造机制，以及一个简单的大气与轨道动力学模拟器。看起来它还打算加入热量模拟和一些船员互动模拟。游戏里有一种假想中的远距离航行，但它已经bug到毫无用处，尽管我尝试了几十次，还是没能让自动驾驶把我带到任何其他地方附近。注意，你必须使用自动驾驶，因为你无法手动使用远距离驱动器。角色除非你每隔几小时手动喂他们一次，否则就会死，这也让远距离航行变得极其烦人。在快进时让他们自动消耗食物、水和睡觉本该是件很简单的事，但他们却只会随机死掉。

而且对此真的没什么可说的。主游戏循环包括打捞各种废弃飞船、逐步建造自己的飞船、偿还你在初始飞船上的贷款，同时避免在燃料和氧气上花太多钱。这方面还算有点意思，但游戏的主要难点本质上就是记住你把某样东西放在哪里了。这让用备用零件进行建造和修理变得很繁琐。只追踪少数几种在机制上不同的地板，并把地板贴图与类型分开，会是个好主意，墙壁也是如此。造船很有趣，但由于存储机制而相当繁琐。电力机制非常不透明，而且没有办法看到某样东西会消耗多少电。有一个角色成长系统，嗯，也许吧，它仍然会提升你已经拥有的技能，而当它们终于达到100%时，你什么也得不到，但它看起来确实存在……所需的工作量也变化极大且不成比例。战斗和对话很糟糕，同样主要是因为糟糕的UI。如果进入一种不同类型的菜单来处理这些，而不是需要四处滚动并猜测东西是干什么的，那会更好。

还应该有与管理食物、饮水、大气和热量相关的难度，但这些系统维护起来几乎微不足道，或者就是有bug。也没有食物、饮水、废物等的回收利用，没有温室，而且奇怪的是没有太阳能板或放射性同位素发电机。偶尔的断电、断燃料或导航站崩溃都是有趣的迷你事件，但在某些情况下可能惩罚过重。

有一个有趣的角色创建过程，但它相当有限，而且在不知道任何东西是干什么的情况下，乐趣也会减少。

问题在于bug。比如你的角色毫无明确理由地装备上太空头盔，然后在空气耗尽后失去意识，而当时你还在自己飞船内部，那里的大气明明没问题。比如各种角色状态条难以解读，或者同样有bug。比如几个月都不需要上厕所，然后突然因为过去几分钟内没上过厕所而反复濒临死亡。比如如果你在某个地方待上几个小时，空间站人员就会像苍蝇一样倒下，留下他们的贵重物品。比如失去左键点击物体的能力，而这是主要的交互方式；比如角色以各种方式随机自杀。游戏加载和保存也慢得惊人，而这是修复大多数bug的唯一方法。请升级到带arena的protobuf，别再使用压缩的json了……另外，游戏在搜索有效路径和有效拖运位置时，非常需要为A*提供更长的搜索范围。

这款游戏真的很有前景，但还没准备好发布。如果你愿意忍受大量不直观的UI和粗糙感，游戏目前这样也挺好玩，但它仍然需要大量工作。

Whilst this game could allow for a lot replayability it has problems.

It lacks basic features that would improve the game a lot, it is needlessly complicated in some areas and front loaded. Yet somehow shallow. It lacks info about what anything does, like player traits.

Here is some simple things, what I think it needs as a priority:
Unable to quit to main menu from character creation, in case you pressed wrong button or wanna try again. 'Continue' on titlescreen is often for continuing a last save, should probably be called 'load'.
For some reason container items need to be interacting with and you need to select 'inventory'. Look I love inventory management, heck I love CDDA, but requiring the game to be unpaused to look at your items is not good. I cannot stress the amount this reduced my enjoyment. Having to check everythings inventory is tedious.
Unable to label or change name of items, that glass bottle of 'vodka' you have for coffee? Yeah your gonna have to use the previous inventory checking each time you want to go through your stuff, as you can't tell at a glance what's in it?
Using control to pick up single items from a stack is impossible, you use control to instead 'place' one from the stack? Seems backwards.
Kicks you out of nav panel on ships when closing the ship menu, very annoying when you are learning the game and after still annoying.
No way to 'cancel' a move command easily.
The ship travel menu is a mess, trying to move around the map is sensitive and annoying, Trying to figure out your heading AND viewing your target is very difficult. This COULD be forgiven if better navigation parts are added later, but I seriously doubt such poor UI would be on every ship in galaxy. You can't even get predictions on where an object is travel that you have targeted, or even the angle between you and the target.

Other areas to improve:
The OST is not very good, it could use better music. I turned it off after a bit. The first one is good for the character creation though.
Traits that do nothing.
Poor variety of items and parts, every ship starts to look the same in terms of parts.
All ships have the same UI?
Some traits or skills aren't trainable?
Unclear to the players when stuff needs to be paid.
No 'buffer' for new characters from fees, means 100% your first character you spent time on will be a waste, should be able to 'pre' save already built characters with same parents, etc.
Changing your last name does not affect your origins.
All the 'mothers' I get look like dudes, tested 8/10 times, same with weird looking fathers. Why assign parents at all? They don't appear to affect your story in the slightest? Character creation options are limited, n general the options for females in particular are bad, I tried playing a few times and once it gave me a female character, after wasting time making a character I realised that it just puts a different face only, it kinda looks goofy on top of the default male body. But across the board it is lacking, you can't even make a character that looks like the loading screens... or even 'normal' looking.
The loan system for your ship seems a bit weird? You can loan for a $800,000 ship, but can't for a $80,000 + some extra like gear? Or a license? I dunno man. Stuff doesn't make sense, in the description of one ship it mentions you worked on it... why can't you work on the cheapest ship?
The LONG saving times, are an issue.
The character creation is sometimes annoying, 'seek ship' should not show the same ship more then once, even if it adds more time the next time you look.
NPCs steal your items? Items disappearing? Had to reload as a core item like my helmet disappeared.
Uninstalling parts in your ship and they appear outside the ship... serious issue as there is no way to go outside? Even from port?


I tried to enjoy this game as it seems to have all the elements for a game I would enjoy but it is half baked at least for now and I just don't. It ain't even that deep either, even though it seems complicated up front, once you play a little bit it is a really simple game.

Still all that said I still think this will be a good game after some updates, unfortunately from what I can see that would take at least 3 years at current rate of development to where I would consider this game playable.

虽然这款游戏可能允许大量重复游玩，但它存在问题。

它缺乏能大幅改善游戏的基础功能，在某些方面不必要地复杂且前置内容过多。然而不知怎的又很浅薄。它缺乏关于任何东西作用的说明，比如玩家特质。

以下是一些简单的事情，我认为它需要优先处理：
无法从角色创建退出到主菜单，以防你按错了按钮或想再试一次。标题画面上的“继续”通常是用来继续上次存档的，可能应该叫“加载”。
不知为何容器物品需要与之互动，然后你需要选择“库存”。听着，我喜欢库存管理，见鬼，我喜欢CDDA，但要求游戏取消暂停才能查看你的物品并不好。我无法强调这减少了我多少乐趣。不得不检查每样东西的库存很乏味。
无法给物品贴标签或更改名称，你那瓶用来配咖啡的“伏特加”玻璃瓶？是啊，每次你想翻找你的东西时，都得用之前说的检查库存，因为你无法一眼看出里面是什么？
使用control从一堆物品中拾取单个物品是不可能的，你用control反而是从堆里“放置”一个？似乎反了。
在飞船上关闭飞船菜单时，会把你踢出导航面板，在你学习游戏时非常烦人，之后仍然烦人。
没有简单的方法“取消”移动命令。
飞船旅行菜单一团糟，试图在地图上移动既敏感又烦人，试图弄清你的航向同时查看你的目标非常困难。如果以后加入更好的导航部件，这还可以原谅，但我严重怀疑银河系每艘飞船上都会有这么糟糕的UI。你甚至无法获得你所瞄准物体移动方向的预测，甚至无法获得你与目标之间的角度。

其他需要改进的地方：
原声带不太好，可以用更好的音乐。我听了一会儿就关掉了。不过第一首对角色创建来说不错。
毫无作用的特质。
物品和部件种类贫乏，每艘飞船在部件方面开始看起来都一样。
所有飞船都有相同的UI？
有些特质或技能无法训练？
玩家不清楚什么时候需要付费。
新角色没有针对费用的“缓冲”，意味着你花时间创建的第一个角色100%会白费，应该能够“预先”保存已经创建好的、拥有相同父母等的角色。
更改你的姓氏不会影响你的出身。
我得到的所有“母亲”看起来都像男人，测试了8/10次，长相奇怪的“父亲”也一样。为什么要分配父母呢？他们似乎丝毫不影响你的故事？角色创建选项有限，总的来说尤其是女性的选项很糟糕，我试玩了几次，有一次给了我一个女性角色，在浪费时间创建角色后我意识到它只是换了一张不同的脸，放在默认男性身体上看起来有点滑稽。但总体而言它很欠缺，你甚至无法创建一个看起来像加载画面里的角色……甚至看起来“正常”的都不行。
你飞船的贷款系统似乎有点奇怪？你可以贷款买一艘800,000美元的飞船，但不能贷款买一艘80,000美元加一些额外东西比如装备的？或者一张执照？我不知道，老兄。事情说不通，在一艘飞船的描述中提到你曾在它上面工作过……为什么你不能在最便宜的飞船上工作？
漫长的保存时间是个问题。
角色创建有时很烦人，“寻找飞船”应该
不要在你下次查看时再次显示同一艘飞船，即使这会增加更多时间。
NPC会偷你的物品？物品消失？不得不重新加载，因为像我的头盔这样的核心物品消失了。
卸载你飞船上的部件，它们却出现在飞船外面……严重问题，因为根本没有办法出去？甚至从港口也不行？


我试着享受这款游戏，因为它似乎具备了一款我会喜欢的游戏的所有元素，但至少目前它是半生不熟的，我就是不喜欢。它甚至也没那么有深度，尽管乍一看似乎很复杂，一旦你玩上一小会儿，它其实是一款非常简单的游戏。

尽管如此，我仍然认为在经过一些更新后这会是一款好游戏，不幸的是，据我所见，以目前的开发速度，至少需要3年才能达到我认为这款游戏可玩的程度。

真的试着去喜欢它吧，我来自类似《太空站13》这样的游戏。

我感觉我一直在和操控较劲，反应迟钝，而且游戏感觉非常粗糙，这也没帮助，还有巨大的卡顿峰值，游戏会直接停住……切换区域，即使区域很小，似乎也比在其他任何游戏里加载巨大地图花的时间更长。

机器人\AI\NPC很难交谈，而且用来和他们交谈的菜单也被用于所有其他互动，从和某人交谈、等待回应，到加速速度，结果却点到一个攻击动作，而它现在就在你刚刚点击用来友好交谈的同一个位置，这种情况并不少见……UI真的需要一个巨大的体验优化，不是试图把菜单瞄准在底部，而是应该放在鼠标光标附近，或者放在正在互动的物体附近……还有天哪，那些延迟……我不知道这是不是归结为游戏打磨的问题，但很多时候就是会有随机的“卡顿？”峰值……

不如先专注于哪些地方能用，在我逐一细数所有不能用的地方之前，比如试图找到船体上那个有一个洞的那一个像素，而它还可能被上面的物体挡住。

所以哪些能用：
- 总体上的建造，拆解\建造能用……虽然游戏以几乎接近现实的水平来模拟它们，所以会花上一阵子，这倒还好，尤其是因为你通常可以把它放着自行处理你自己飞船维修的最基础中的最基础部分……遗憾的是，这游戏远远不是关于你的飞船的。
- 加速\减速，不管怎么说吧……这游戏真的需要它现有的速度倍率，甚至需要更高的x32。

哪些不能用：
- AI\机器人\NPC总体来说不行，但至少我们知道自己在面对什么
- 建造，撇开那些关于最基础骨架内容的所有优点不谈，一旦你开始处理其他飞船，或者你只是想修理空间站（天哪，别指望你能做你想做的事），那它就只能是单一目标，每个任务都是如此，即使他们增加了排队的能力，你仍然在和层叠的东西较劲……比如覆盖墙壁的电线，如果你在一艘残骸上，想修很多墙壁\船体，一般来说……如果船很大，那你就完蛋了。
- UI，天哪……这UI真是另一回事……从启动游戏、点击新游戏\加载，到你在游玩过程中不得不与之搏斗的各种繁琐弯弯绕绕，比如你可能正在和一个NPC交谈……你现在被迫使用的上下文菜单会显示敌对动作，而且由于和NPC交谈时的漫长延迟，你很可能正以高速游玩，更别提有时你会想交谈的NPC数量，如果你花太久，他们还会移动或离开该区域，这游戏迫切需要精简流程，并把菜单放在合乎逻辑的位置……我很害怕那些全屏“故事”画面的时刻……大多数都毫无道理……
- 体验优化……UI本来就已经很痛苦了，但这游戏有太多地方迫切需要体验优化……要写下来的清单太长了

Update 15/02/25 (American: 02/15/25):
Since this review, some of these issues have been addressed, while others still remain.

Improvements:
- Crew AI is a little more flexible than it used to be, with some basic priorities for task categories. Crew are more useful than goldfish now, but you will still need to babysit them a little
- NPCs no longer suffocate themselves (mostly)
- Crashes are much more uncommon (although not rare)
- A much more living world. Long-distance travel (and reasons to do so) has since been added, and it's quite satisfying.
- It's down from 80% of time spent fighting bugs to nearly 0%, even in the current test build. Although 65% is still spent fighting design mechanics.

Persistent issues:
- Performance. It's playable on most PCs, but it really chugs. Loading times between zones break immersion frequently
- Inventory management. With a little finesse, you can get a working system set up for salvaging, but you'll always be doing it on the game's terms, not your own. Get ready for a lot of micromanagement.
- AI intelligence. Crew will fetch items one by one, with little concern for efficiency. They follow a very simple series of instructions, in the order you give them, so you'll need to spend about 5 hours learning how to trick them into working the way you want them to and doing the bulk of the menial tasks manually. This is probably the area most ripe for improvement.

Overall, bugs are being crushed, content is expanding (albeit slightly), and core mechanic choices remain a persistent thorn in an otherwise singular game.

It's still a not-recommend for me in its current state, but development progression is promising, so keep an eye on this. Give it another year; it's still heading for an easy recommend.

-------------------

It's a great deal of fun. The fundamental game loop is enjoyable, and the community is quite active (albeit only on discord and not on Steam, which is kind of sus). Plus the developer is reasonably renowned (neo scavenger was excellent, although relatively more barren in content than its system is innovative. I'm hoping Ostranauts won't reach a similar apex).

Once it's in a proper Beta state, this will be an EASY recommend.

However, in its current state, it's exceptionally clunky, buggy, and unrefined.
- Crew AI doesn't offer much yet. They're not much more than liabilities at the moment. But it's more enjoyable if you imagine them as pet goldfish.
- NPCs have a great range of needs, which is nice, but it's more than their current AI is able to respond to. NPCs will suffocate themselves in their own suit; stand at the airlock trying to get to a TV on the station (which you've disallowed them from entering) instead of going to your very nice rec room; and are generally very confused about what they can and can't do.
- Task and hauling management is unreliable and inefficient, it's faster to do everything manually. You can set zones for items, but the UI options are highly limited and auto-hauling seems to exist (because I find items randomly moved around the ship), but I have no idea by what logic. You'll need to manually select items to be hauled and hope you've set up your zones to be close enough to what you want. You can set construction orders and set your crew to automatically build it, but: they will collect items one by one as they build them. And good luck trying to get a crew to handle tasks collaboratively: more often than not, they just make it harder for each other to get anything done.
- And the usual list of bugs you'd expect from a complex game in Alpha, causing you to resort to debug menus, off-and-on, and loading earlier saves.

Overall, it has fantastic potential. It should be in your wishlist and follow list, and ranked amongst the top of them.
Devs are focusing on feature development more than stability, so it's a fun time if (like me), you don't mind working through a bunch of jank to play with some cool toys.

If you want to enjoy the experience, check back in a year. This is a classic early-access title.
If you're willing and able to spend 80% of your game time fighting against bugs and clunky mechanics, come and join!

- 崩溃变得少见多了（尽管并不罕见）
- 一个更加鲜活的世界。远距离旅行（以及这样做的理由）此后已被加入，而且相当令人满意。
- 从花 80% 的时间与 bug 搏斗降到几乎 0%，即使在当前的测试版本中也是如此。不过仍有 65% 的时间花在与设计机制搏斗上。

持续存在的问题：
- 性能。它在大多数 PC 上都能玩，但确实很卡。区域之间的加载时间经常破坏沉浸感
- 物品栏管理。稍加技巧，你就能为打捞建立一个可用的系统，但你始终是在按游戏的规则行事，而不是你自己的。准备好面对大量的微观管理吧。
- AI 智能。船员会一件一件地取物品，几乎不考虑效率。他们遵循一系列非常简单的指令，按你给出的顺序执行，所以你需要花大约 5 个小时学习如何诱使他们按你想要的方式工作，并手动完成大部分琐碎任务。这大概是最有待改进的领域。

总体而言，bug 正在被消灭，内容正在扩展（尽管幅度不大），而核心机制的选择仍然是一根持续存在的刺，扎在这款在其他方面独一无二的游戏里。

就目前的状态而言，对我来说仍然是不推荐，但开发进展很有希望，所以请继续关注这款游戏。再给它一年时间；它仍然有望轻松获得推荐。

-------------------

它非常有趣。基本的游戏循环令人愉快，社区也相当活跃（尽管只在 Discord 上而不在 Steam 上，这有点可疑）。此外，开发者相当有名（《新拾荒者》非常出色，尽管其内容相对而言比其系统的创新性更为贫瘠。我希望《Ostranauts》不会达到类似的顶峰）。

一旦它进入正式的 Beta 状态，这将是一款轻松推荐的作品。

然而，在目前的状态下，它异常笨拙、bug 多且未经打磨。
- 船员 AI 目前还提供不了太多东西。此刻他们不过是负担而已。但如果你把他们想象成宠物金鱼，就会更有趣一些。
- NPC 有种类繁多的需求，这很好，但这超出了他们当前 AI 所能应对的范围。NPC 会在自己的宇航服里把自己闷死；站在气闸处试图去够空间站上的一台电视（而你已经禁止他们进入那里），而不是去你非常漂亮的娱乐室；而且总体上非常搞不清自己能做什么、不能做什么。
- 任务和搬运管理不可靠且低效，手动做所有事情反而更快。你可以为物品设置区域，但 UI 选项极其有限，而且自动搬运似乎存在（因为我发现物品在飞船里被随机移动），但我完全不知道它是按什么逻辑运作的。你需要手动选择要搬运的物品，并祈祷你设置的区域足够接近你想要的效果。你可以设置建造订单并让船员自动建造，但是：他们在建造时会一件一件地收集物品。而且，祝你好运，试着让船员协作处理任务：大多数情况下，他们只会让彼此更难完成任何事情。
- 还有你在 Alpha 阶段的复杂游戏中会预料到的那一长串常见 bug，迫使你时不时地求助于调试菜单，并反复加载较早的存档。

总体而言，它有着极佳的潜力。它应该在你的愿望单和关注列表里，并且排在其中的前列。
开发者更专注于功能开发而非稳定性，所以如果你（像我一样）不介意克服一堆毛病来玩一些很酷的东西，那会是一段有趣的时光。

如果你想享受这段体验，请一年后再回来看看。这是一款典型的抢先体验作品。

items.text:
Absolutely great potential for a game and the creator seems to be working diligently on it. I most definitely recommend this game if you're a fan of DF style games.

If you love DF, Rimworld or any of the other top-down games in DF style, Ostranauts is most likely for you. The learning curve is steep like DF, and if you don't pay attention during the tutorial messages (like I did), you'll end up hauling every part by hand, not realising there is zones you can create to save hauling your haul of 14 doors, 2 reactors, 6 tanks one by one, all by hand, enduring a ~5 minute transition period to the blackmarket to pawn your haul per item, only to realise the guy has switched to paying under market rate for your Reactor and you have to wait another 5 minutes to hope he'll offer a reasonable price again. Took me ~25 hours of doing this before I followed the tutorial message on a new save.

Another tip: Most definitely don't decide to ransack the cops ship when they're docked to your ship. Within ~2 minutes of being on his ship (with him trying to fly away still docked), both our ships were looking more holy than a Nang Huffer's brain. The haul of 2 EVA batteries weren't worth the complete rebuild of my ship at the start of the game. Great moments of this game make it completely a steal for the price.

Since it is in early access, expect many, many crashes and bugs. Autosaving seems to be a big issue from my experience, the game runs best with it switched off. Once I've gotten about 16 hours on a save, autosaving (set to every 1 hour) takes ~45 minutes per save with a 1/3 chance of it crashing the game during saving. Especially at the OKLN station with several ships worth of loot on board. The game is definitely getting better with every update.

There was a rather annoying bug where every time my character felt an emotion (like remissness or name drop), it would stay on the ship as a blocked tile. Really bloody annoying but work-around-able. Thank you to the Devs for patching it in the last release.

这款游戏绝对有巨大的潜力，而且创作者似乎正在勤奋地开发它。如果你是DF风格游戏的粉丝，我绝对推荐这款游戏。

如果你喜欢DF、Rimworld或任何其他DF风格的俯视角游戏，Ostranauts很可能适合你。学习曲线像DF一样陡峭，如果你在教程消息期间不注意（就像我一样），你最终会手动搬运每一个部件，没有意识到你可以创建区域来省去一件一件手动搬运你那14扇门、2个反应堆、6个罐子的收获，忍受大约5分钟的过渡时间到黑市去典当你的每件收获，结果却发现那家伙已经改成以低于市场价的价格收购你的反应堆，而你必须再等5分钟，希望他会再次给出合理的价格。我这样做了大约25个小时，才在一个新存档里遵循了教程消息。

另一个提示：绝对不要决定在警察的船停靠在你船上时洗劫它。在他船上大约2分钟内（他还试图在仍然停靠的情况下飞走），我们两艘船看起来都比Nang Huffer的大脑还要圣洁。2块EVA电池的收获不值得在游戏初期对我的船进行彻底重建。这款游戏的精彩时刻让它以这个价格来说完全是白捡的。

由于它处于抢先体验阶段，预计会有很多很多崩溃和bug。根据我的经验，自动保存似乎是个大问题，关闭它游戏运行最好。一旦我在一个存档上玩了大约16个小时，自动保存（设置为每1小时一次）每次保存大约需要45分钟，并且有1/3的几率在保存期间导致游戏崩溃。尤其是在OKLN空间站，船上载着好几艘船价值的战利品时。这款游戏肯定随着每次更新都在变得更好。

有一个相当烦人的bug，每次我的角色感受到一种情绪（比如悔恨或点名），它都会留在船上成为一个被阻挡的格子。真是烦人得要命，但可以绕过。感谢开发者在最后一个版本中修补了它。

Personally I love this game already.  However I'm a weirdo who can get past brutally awkward UIs and crazy amounts of jank to see a game with a cool idea and a lot of promise.

At this point, Aug 2023, it's just promise and needs a lot of content before I'd recommend it to anyone I know.  Fixing the UI and the jank would also be good, but for now I think a big part of it is that there just isn't all that much to do in the game before you've seen it all

Dec 2024 and I'm updating my review comments.  There seems to be more to do, which is good, but I'm also encountering way more bugs of the "reload from save" variety.  Having to reload also makes the long load times more painful.

At this point I'm reasonably certain the game is doomed and that makes me sad, because I love the theme, the high detail, and a lot of what they've done with this game as a concept

Aug 2026 and it's hit 1.0, the bugs are pretty well resolved, however I think ultimitely it's still a no recommend from me, ambitious game but the jank factor is too high.  Load times are still too long and it just feels a lot more like work than fun

10/2025 review 
I dunno what to do with the previous reviews so I just am going to keep them below.  I was thinking I should delete it, but maybe its interesting, and maybe it adds color to my current review.  Forgive me if I ramble

I'd say this has hit what I would call early access/can recommend.  I need to caution you however, I have a lot of hours in this game so I'm already past a lot of the needed learning curve and my perceptions are not accurate to a new player.  You are going to be slapped in the face with the amount of crap you need to know & get comfortable doing required things without thinking about it and you are going to be frustrated when you don't realize your starting space suit has no air supply to it, or that you have to and can move your flashlight and tools around your inventory, or you forget to put the helmet on or off to refresh the oxygen, or the fact that the ship airlock is poorly done so you won't be using it properly, or what the hell do all these things on my debt ship do since none of them look intuitive.  Expect to spend a lot of time looking up answers on youtube lets plays or google.

They still has a fair bit to add, but  it feels like they are midway through the beta.  No real story content yet and I think this game will be in DIRE need of it relative to what the devs have planned/ going to copy the mini storys of neo scavenger.

This is very much a "hardcore" game where you will get satisfaction from 2 things:  Realizing how screwed you are at the beginning of the game and trying to figure out how to get out of Debt Hell, and watching your stuff count, ship size and numbers go up.

Outside of those two things, there's nothing really satisfying.  The game's design feels like it was designed by an engineer with an extra dose of introverted engineerness.  What I mean by that is most of the mechanics were designed with "step by step what does a person need" "Step by step how do I slowly put a ship together"  "step by step how do I do x."  Sure its not that detailed versus real life, but I feel like this game was designed by a sentient technical manual.

You build your ship up not because your ship is cool but because you want to be annoyed less.  Its kind of neat that you can put in living quarters and an extra crew mate and toilets for them and exercise machines yada yada but none of those elements are really satisfying because the underlying game is almost meant to be meticulous with very little payoff besides removing things that annoy you.

You run around trying to erase your debt because of the regular payments that feel game ending.  You run around trying to build your ship so you can more effectively scavenge and erase your debt.  You run around nice-afying your ship because you got a crewmate and you don't want them to leave or be unhappy.  Its a game that pushes you and you enjoy rising to the challenge.  Look at all of the hours I've spent on the game.  There is something there, but I feel like a lot of those hours were my guys 24/7 wearing full space gear and working a ship building/scavenging shift.  It almost felt like I was watching a job.

Some elements of the game represent the dev's willingness to think in wacky ways outside of game design norms.  I don't think anyone playing the game thinks well of the social interaction and needs system.  It just feels needlessly complicated and when understood, unnecessary.  Oh no your crewmate misses his family! Click the social buttons and watch as that crewmate slowly writes home 3 separate times *poof* fixed, now he no longer misses home.  I don't want to sound to harsh because its that very dev's willingness to do new game systems that makes his game so interesting but it ends up being less desirable after time goes on.  Nor does it feel very realistic.  Your guy who misses home, that writes back home 3x times is not doing it in a comfortable chair in well lit personal quarters- hes doing it in a 24/hr wearing stinky space suit in a poorly lit derelict with broken ♥♥♥♥ everywhere in the vacuum of space.

You constantly get pinged social requests that are unrewarding and pointless- "hey buddy can you give me 20 scrap and I'll like you more"  "hey buddy I want a non-binary lover, can you get me that"  "Hey buddy can you tell someone to leave me alone." "Hey buddy" "Hey buddy" "Hey buddy"
You will feel next to 0 motivation to fulfill these requests and they will linger on your screen.  When you click remove to them, more of them will pop up as if you are being haunted by the games social request system.

I haven't fired up my reactor to run long range with my ship yet- about 90% ready for it but I don't think I want to go that far either since I don't see a lot of content there.   There is more money doing that I think, but since you cobble together ships there is need to since there is nothing you are really going to want with the money-  there is no "I need to get money because THAT SHIP IS SO COOL".

if I think of anything else to add I'll drop it in this updated.

Listen....

Not yet.  I mean, keep it on your watch list if you liked Neo Scavenger like I did but wow.  When this game was first released it was a pre alpha tech demo.  Its gone from unplayable to more like not great.

Scavenging is fun, but its poorly done.  The load screens are a nightmare, there are still bugs, most things don't totally make sense.  I'm not really sure this game is going to take off or not just because nothing besides the core scavenging is ok.  Core scavenging mechanics are not enough to carry this game.   I'm concerned about the overall vision of the project but who knows. 

I bought this because I liked Neo Scav, I don't really regret it but I really cannot recommend buy this unless you are hoping that with the $ the dev can pull off whatever he has planned...I'm not really sure Dev will make it but I wish the best of luck.


7/19/2024 update
--------------------
One year later I gave it a swing.  I'm seeing optimization, less crashes and less bugs.  Load screens are now downgraded from nightmare to just annoying. Bug level has dropped down to mildly annoying.  The game freezes for too long whenever it auto saves.

Now that the game feels a bit cleaner the choices dev made feel poorly planned.  K-Leg has  a couple of different zones and I don't understand why that's needed/ it just introduces annoying loading screens.

I took 2 quests the game sent my way from my contacts and o boy are they stupid:
  I completed one quest by going to load area A, asking for the quest, then going to load area B, asking a 2nd person about the quest and then back to A to speak to original quest giver.  Quest complete.......

My 2nd quest was to find a non binary/gay lover for someone.  So I went around the station asking if they would be a non-binary/gay lover for the quest giver.  After asking 3-4 people I then asked the quest giver from quest 1 and he said yes.  Quest complete.....

I stabbed 2 pirates in this run through.  That's new, but not really different.  Now when you scavenge stuff bring a knife and a combat skill.

The worst part is that....I already have had fun with Ostranauts.  This replay one year later I got the same fun as from last year.  I really didn't experience the year of changes and while I could go seek out the new supernatural stuff , I feel like its just going to be disappointing and not worth it.  I could go out and buy a ship or build out my own...but again it doesn't seem to be worth it to me.  Nothing is really fluid/seamless in the game so I don't feel like its worth all the jank to go exploring and enjoy meh experiences or building a ship and having a crew in it with dumb social mini game.

2025年10月评论
我不知道该怎么处理之前的评论，所以我就把它们留在下面了。我本来想删掉它，但也许它挺有意思的，也许它能给我当前的评论增添点色彩。如果我啰嗦了，请原谅我

我想说这游戏已经达到了我会称之为抢先体验/可以推荐的程度。不过我得提醒你，我在这游戏里已经玩了很多小时，所以我早就越过了很多必要的学习曲线，我的看法对新玩家来说并不准确。你会被迎面而来的大量你需要知道的东西打脸，还得习惯不假思索地做那些必须做的事，而且当你没意识到你初始的太空服没有供气、或者你得在物品栏里挪动手电筒和工具、或者你忘了戴上或摘下头盔来刷新氧气、或者飞船气闸做得太烂所以你根本没法正确使用它、或者我欠债的那艘船上这些东西到底是干嘛的因为它们看起来一点都不直观时，你会感到沮丧。准备好花大量时间在YouTube实况或谷歌上查答案吧。

他们还有相当多东西要加，但感觉他们正处在测试版的中途。还没有真正的剧情内容，而且我认为相对于开发者所计划的/将要照抄《新拾荒者》那些小故事而言，这游戏会极其需要剧情。

这非常是一款“硬核”游戏，你会从两件事中获得满足感：意识到自己在游戏开局时处境有多惨，并设法弄清楚如何摆脱债务地狱；以及看着你的物资数量、飞船规模和数字往上涨。

除了这两件事之外，真没什么让人满足的。这游戏的设计感觉像是一个工程师设计的，还额外加了一份内向的工程宅气质。我的意思是，大多数机制都是按照“一步一步，一个人需要什么”“一步一步，我怎么慢慢把一艘飞船拼起来”“一步一步，我怎么做X”来设计的。当然，跟现实生活比起来没那么细致，但我感觉这游戏就像是由一本有自我意识的技术手册设计的。

你升级你的飞船，不是因为你的飞船很酷，而是因为你想少受点烦。你能装上居住舱、多一名船员、给他们配马桶和健身器材之类的，这确实有点意思，但这些元素没有哪个真正让人满足，因为底层游戏几乎就是刻意追求一丝不苟，除了移除那些烦你的东西之外几乎没什么回报。

你四处奔波试图抹掉你的债务，因为那些定期付款感觉会让游戏直接结束。你四处奔波试图建造你的飞船，这样你就能更有效地拾荒并抹掉你的债务。你四处奔波把你的飞船弄得舒服点，因为你有了一个船员，你不想他们离开或不开心。这是一款推动你前进的游戏，而你喜欢迎难而上。看看我在这游戏上花了多少小时吧。那里确实有点东西，但我感觉其中很多小时都是我的角色24/7穿着全套太空装备，干着造飞船/拾荒的班。几乎感觉像是我在看一份工作。

游戏的一些元素体现了开发者愿意以古怪的方式跳出游戏设计常规去思考。我不认为任何玩这游戏的人会对社交互动和需求系统有好评价。它就是感觉没必要地复杂，而一旦理解了，又觉得没必要。哦不，你的船员想家了！点击社交按钮，然后看着那个船员慢慢往家里写3封独立的信*噗*修好了，现在他不再想家了。我不想说得太苛刻，因为正是那位开发者愿意做新游戏系统的意愿让他的游戏如此有趣，但随着时间推移，它最终变得不那么令人满意。它感觉也不太真实。你那个想家的家伙，往家里写3封信，可不是坐在光线充足的个人舱室里舒适的椅子上写的——他是在24小时穿着发臭的太空服，在一个光线昏暗、真空里到处是破烂玩意儿的废弃飞船里写的。

你会不断收到毫无回报又毫无意义的社交请求——“嘿哥们，能给我20个废料吗，我会更喜欢你”“嘿哥们，我想要个非二元性别恋人，你能给我弄来吗”“嘿哥们，你能叫某个人别烦我吗。”“嘿哥们”“嘿哥们”“嘿哥们”
你会觉得几乎没有动力去满足这些请求，而它们会一直留在你的屏幕上。当你点击移除它们时，会有更多弹出来，就好像你被这游戏的社交请求系统缠身了一样。

我还没启动我的反应堆让飞船进行远程航行——大约准备好了90%，但我觉得我也不想走那么远，因为我在那里看不到很多内容。我觉得那样做能赚更多钱，但既然你是拼凑飞船的，那就没必要，因为有了钱你也没什么真正想要的东西——没有那种“我需要搞到钱，因为那艘飞船太酷了”。

AS OF 6th November of 2023 when I decided to revisit this game. This game is still in a very early state. Progress has been made. It doesn't seem to like Linux or M2 drives, somehow this makes loading very slow. Although I am not sure if it has anything to do with Linux, as much as it has to do with the drive. The game loaded just fine on my laptop using a SATA SSD.

Old review below:

Conceptually excellent for fans of "hard sci-fi" or anyone that has recently read or watched the Expanse.

And that's about as far as you will get with Ostranauts. 

This is still, in what I'd call a pre-early access state. I have my suspicions that the game was tossed on steam to acquire additional budgeting. Which I am actually fine with if this game gets anywhere. For that reason I did not refund the game, but I did find it to be incredibly broken (more broken than any other early access titles I've ever played). For instance I accelerated a little and pressed the fast forward button. Nothing happened. I walk away from the console, I am suddenly in open space with nothing around me.

You can expect that kind of broken and more if you read other reviews and steam discussions which quickly point to suffocating with a suit full of oxygen, hypoxia even if you have a pressurized suit and so on.

I wish the devs the best of luck and will change my review when my expectations meet what I've seen from other early access titles I've bought and when the price is fully justified.
items.text_zh:
截至2023年11月6日，当我决定重新体验这款游戏时。这款游戏仍处于非常早期的阶段。已经取得了一些进展。它似乎不喜欢Linux或M2硬盘，不知何故这导致加载非常缓慢。虽然我不确定这是否与Linux有关，还是更多与硬盘有关。游戏在我的笔记本电脑上使用SATA SSD加载得很好。

以下是旧评测：

对于“硬科幻”爱好者或任何最近读过或看过《苍穹浩瀚》的人来说，概念上非常出色。

而这就是你在《Ostranauts》中能走到的极限了。

这仍然处于我所说的抢先体验前状态。我怀疑这款游戏被扔到Steam上是为了获取额外预算。如果这款游戏能有所发展，我实际上对此没意见。出于这个原因我没有退款，但我确实发现它极其破碎（比我玩过的任何其他抢先体验游戏都要破碎）。例如，我稍微加速了一下然后按了快进按钮。什么都没发生。我离开控制台，突然就身处空旷太空，周围什么都没有。

如果你读其他评测和Steam讨论，你可以预期那种破碎以及更多问题，那些讨论很快指出穿着充满氧气的套装却窒息、即使穿着加压服也会缺氧等等。

我祝开发者们好运，当我的期望与我买过的其他抢先体验游戏所见到的一致时，当价格完全合理时，我会改变我的评测。
